title: Muteya Buha Engubi
alias: Watchman Blow The Trumpet##CH 619-Doh is Bb
content: Muteya buha engubi, Ukunge mundu ghosi#Oyukow’engulu eyi, Atsire amalolo.##ERISUBA MO :#Muteya we buh’engubi, Ibughaye kutsibu#Minyisy’abosi engulu, Balwe omo miriki.##Ubuhire y’oko bitwa, Omoli n’omo misya;#Kandi n’omo ngetsi hosi, Baminye erilama.##Ubughaye y’omo nzira, N’ahabisire hosi;#Tat’akabalindirira, Byosi byabiryusula.##Buhira abatohire, Nabo balamibawe,#Yesu akabirikira, Mwase mulamibawa.

title: Bwakere Ndeke
alias: Kumekushca kwa Uzuru N° 6 Sw.#(The Morning Bright With Rosy Light)##CH 18 - Doh is Ab
content: Bwakere ndeke tupipe, Twangingul’ameso,#Tata amatuwatikya, Nyiri Mwana wawe.##Mwami ngandisiba nawe, Mo buteya bwawe,#Unyibuyire ebibi, Mby’omo byala byawe.##Kirimu kyawe kikale, Mo mutima waghe,#Kinyeraye, ngalangire, Obubuya bwawe.

title: Omukama Anemwasa
alias: The Coming King##CH 546-Doh is G
content: Omukama anemwasa, Oyowatwanza kwenene ;#Anemwasa erilamya, Abamwasi bosi##ERISUBA MO :#Ko luyi, ko luyi, Mwami Yesu any’oko luyi#Anemwasa, anemwasa, Mulamya oko luyi.##Binyikalo by’endata, Byabiriberererera;#Linw’endambi y’erilama, Lero mwikirirye.##Amalwa asyaby’atyahwa, Sihendisyabya buholo;#Nikw’ebibi n’oluholo, Byasyaghuswa kundu.##Nery’omo kihugho kihya, Twasikala n’erikota,#Sihendisyaby’oluholo, Hate n’obulighe.

title: Nyamuhanga Wetu
alias: Mungu Msaada Wetu N° 7 Sw.#(O God Our Help In Ages Past)##CH 81 - Doh is Ab
content: Nyamuhanga uli ngabo, Emighulu yosi,#Niwe ‘Yiketera ryetu, Ekera na kara.##Ekitsutsu ky’Ekitumbi, Lukengerwa lwawe,#Buteya bwetu bukalwa, Ewaw’elubula.##Sitwetwatabilola ko, Mo kihugho kino,#Uli Mwami Mwenge wetu, Tuli n’obuholo.##Birimo bighonye kw’Iwe, Ni kiro kighuma,#Wasyatuteya ehosi, Tuli bandu bawe.##Nyamuhanga uli ngabo, Emighulu yosi,#Muteya wetu na ngabo, Ebirimo byosi.

title: Nasyamulangira
alias: Face To Face##CH 545-Doh is Bb(Moderato)
content: Nasyamulangira Yesu, Tuli nay’elubula ;#Aho nasyamuminyira, Kwali yo wanyikwira.##ERISUBA MO :#Nasyamulangira Yesu, Tuli nay’elubula,#Nyiminy’erihenia liwe, nasyamupipa kundu.##Lino ngamulindirira, Akandisyasa kandi ;#Ekiro akandisyasa, Ngandisyamulola ko.##Twasyatsemera ewuwe, Ahate n’omulighe ;#Abatyowa wabiryowa, Ah’omwirimya ate.##Twasyatsemer’élubula, Nasyamulangira yo,#Nasyabya na Yesu Kristo, Y’Omulamiya waghe.

title: Erina Lya Yesu Libuya
alias: Jina Lake Yesu Tamu N° 24 Sw.#(How Sweet The Name Of Jesus Sounds)##CH 150 - Doh is Eb
content: Rina rya Yesu Ribuya, Twamarikirirya,#Rikahumulay’omweyo, Twamamwikirirya.##Wamahutala mo mweyo, Ukindilamibwa,#Wamakw’enzal’ighughuta, ‘Wabya n’obutseme.##Rina Eri ni Lukuka, Ngabo, Busayiro,#Rina eri ni Ribuya, Buteke, okw’ingye.##Yesu, Mulisya, Omwira, Mwighisya, Mukara,#Nzuko, Nduli na Amina, Obuteke bwaghe.##Sinangatok’eripipa, Ngoko bitolere,#Ripipa eryo ngateka, Uryangirir’eyo.

title: Asyasa
alias: He’s Coming##CH 669-Doh is Bb (Moderato)
content: Hali engulu yowene eyo buholo, Yabirilwa hali kutsibu ;#Kusangwa Omulamya anemwendisyasa, Kandy’asimya Obwami buwe.##ERISUBA MO :#Asyasa, nyasi akandisyasa, Nikw’asyasa kundu kundu,#Abaghendi bosi, baluha basyaluhukibwa na Nyamuhanga.##Amasinda asyakingukal’ekirw’ekyo, Wa Babuyirir’emuliro ;#Esyondeko syabaghotsere ekulimu, basyikala muna kihugho.##Sihali kindi kikasyatughana kandi, tukandisyimba obutseme ;#Ababiritongolibwa basyalw’ehosi, Basyapipa Omwami wabo.##Haleluy’amina, Haleluy’erikota, Twamasikya twasyikala yo,#Uby’unnasikire kandi ubye n’amaha, Lero wasyambal’Akakira.

title: Ambale Esy'ombita
alias: Taji Mvikeni N° 25 Sw.#(Crown Him With Many Crowns)##CH 162 - Doh is E
content: Ambal’embita, Esyombita nyingi,#Kyana ky’Embuli kitolere, Mwami ow’abami.#Naghe ngamupipa, Oyo wambolera,#Ni Mwamy’akangabasenie, Ndulani y’ewuwe.##Ambal’embita, Mwami gh’obutoki,#Mwabohol’abandu biwe, Mo miriki y’ebibi.#Omuminyereri, Mulisya w’abandu,#Kisiki eky’omwa Yese, W’e Betelehamu.##Ambal’embita, Omwami gh’olwanzo,#Bironda biwe n’ilama, Twabirilamibwa.#Elubula siyiri n’abalaika,#Batebul’eriswekera, Esyongolu siwe.##Ambal’embita, Mwami gh’obuholo,#Hosi hosi ko kihugho, Amalw’asyahwa ho.#N’Obutabali buwe, Bwasyakota yo,#Mwisi w’amaghulu wuwe, Emyatsi yowene.

title: Muteya We Minyisy'endambi
alias: How Far From Homa##CH 665-Doh is Eb
content: Muteya we misnyisy’endambi, Ewetu ni hali kwehi ?#Ati : Mwirimya ni munene, Nikwa bukandikya,#Sighulire, genda luba, Suleke erikirirya,#Nikwa ekiro wasyahika, Kiro ky’erikota.##Umubwire kyabugha nawe, Anzubirya ndeke ati :#Amalwa akisiyinahwa, Sulwe omo malwa,#Sughubahe, sukw’obuba, Yitsinge oko mubiri,#Nikwa twasyaban’ébihembo, Twamabisangana.##Ngabulaya ebyabumbawa, Bikanyisubirya bitya:#Ekihugho kikandisyahwa ho, hasyasa ekindi.#Sulir’ebiminyikalo, Bikakangaya hotuli,#Ebindu byosi byabumbawa bilindir’engubi.##Ewetu si hali kutsibu, Tutseme omo Mitima,#Tuhumule ko twasyalama butsira bulighe.#Sulire twasyahika yo, Bulighe bukandisyahwa,#Sitwendisyabul’obuholo mo Muyi wa Tata.

title: Mwami, Ututsumule
alias: Tutokapo Tubariki N° 26 Sw.#(Lord, Dismiss Us)##CH 33 - Doh is E
content: Lino Mwami tutsumule,#Utuhe eritsema ringi,#Tubwe n’olwanzo lwawe Mulamya,#Lukogho lw’erikinda.#Utuhumulaye, Omw’ibya ho ryetu.#Tukabalamir’Omo Bwami bwawe.##Twamatek’eripipa n’eyisimi,#Oko Kinywa kye Ngulu Mbuya.#Ebighuma by’erilama ryetu,#Bilangirikire okw’itwe.#Biro byosi tubye, Abandu babuya,#Oko Kwenene yawe Mwami wetu.##Ebiro byetu byamabya bingi,#Tubiteker’Omwami Yesu.#Tubye n’akaghala omo mutima,#Situluhire omo nzira.#Erihika omughulu twasyalola,#Okw’ihenia ry’Omwami wetu Kristo.

title: Imwe Babuyirire
alias: Watch Ye Saints##CH 549-Doh is Db
content: Imwe ababuyirire, Muteghaye biro byosi ;#Muhamb’esiseke syenyu, Lind’Omwamy’ali hakuhi.##ERISUBA MO :#Omwami, anemwasa.#Anemwasa n’erihenia, Yesu arimya engoma,#Omwami, anemwasa.##Wibuk’Omuhanganiri, Erilamya n’olukogho ;#Embita n’erisimibwa, Wibuk’erilama eryo.##Sihaly’amami atehwa, Wowe esyongali siwe ;#Bwir’abosi olukogho, Ni ndambi y’erilamibwa.##Ebihanda byasyahwa ho, Kristo let’Obwami bwawe,#Kihugho kisiy’ikahwa, Mutseme babirilama.

title: Utuhy'obuholo
alias: Tupe Amanii N° 26a Sw.#(God The Omnipotent)
content: Mwami gh’olukengerwa yo wabumba,#Erihunga n’emirabyo yosi,#Tek’oluhogho, Iw’ukatabala,#Tuhy’obuholo Mwami Mubuya.##Mwami gh’olukogho, Twabirihalya,#Ko mighambo n’oko Kinywa kyawe,#Hitana ryawe, Siritubughe ho,#Tuhy’obuholo Mwami Mubuya.##Muhangiki wetu : Abandu babi,#Bakaghan’olukengerwa lwawe,#Obubuya bwawe, Ka bwasyakota,#Kangay’Ekwenene Yawe, Mwami.##Tukakuramaya Mulamya wetu,#Busana wabiritutongolya,#Neryo tukimba obubuya bwawe,#Butoki, Lukengerwa : Ni byawe.

title: Asyaswasa, Asyaswasa
alias: When He Comes##CH 415-Doh is E (Moderato)
content: Asyaswasa,  Asyaswasa Omulamya wetu,#Asyatwala, Asyatwala abandu buwe.##ERISUBA MO :#Twasyatsema kutsibu, Erya ewa Yesu.#N’erikota na kera, Situlilwa yo.##Imwe bosi mwangaminya Omwatsi wa Yesu ;#Mwangakwama n’omutima, Imwasyalama.##Yesu Kristo asyaswasa, Ekiro tutasi ;#Umulinde, umulinde ng’Omwami wawe.

title: Olwanzo Lwawe Mulamya
alias: Pendo Lako; Ee Mwokozi N° 37 Sw.#(Love Divine, All Loves Excelling)##CH 142 – Doh .....
content: Lwanzo lwawe Mulamya wetu, Lulabir”ebindu byosi,#Ubye netu, emwisi wetu, Butseme bw’elubula.#Yesu, uli Mughenyeri, Mubuya  omo lukogho,#Humulaya abakalira, Usangule bw’emisonia.##Kirimi kyawe eky’olwanzo, Kitum’okw’itwe bawe,#Tubye n’obutseme bwawe, Obo wabiritulagha,#Utuh’omweyo omubuya, Uli Nzuko, Uli Nduli,#Kalay’Erikirirya ryetu, Tubye n’obwiranda bwawe.##Yesu was’ewetu lino, Tukoky’omo lwanzo lwawe,#As’ewetu kandi, Mwami, Sighutusighanaye,#Twamakupipa muna-bwire, Haghuma n’Abalaika!#Imba n’eritek’eripipa, Wingire Omw’iramya.##Lino, Mwami, Mubiri wawe, Bugha gh’omo mutima,#Weraye E Kanisa yawe, Omwilama eryoswire.#Weray”Ebihangikwa byawe, Oko ndambi ng’eyi Mwami,#Tusabule, tulw’omo bibi, Twingire omo lubula.

title: Ekiro Yesu Asyatwenda
alias: When The Trumpet##C.S. 865-Doh is Ab
content: Ekiro Yesu akasyatwenda abandu buwe ;#N’engunga ya Yesu ikasyabugha,#Abandu buwe bosi bakandisyalwa mwisinda#Twasyahindana erya elubula.##ERISUBA MO :#Nasyabya yo elubula,#Haghuma na Yesu Kristo,#Nasyabya yo elubula:#Ngandikwama Yesu mo nzira syosi.##Yesu amatubirikira omo mitima yetu ;#Syanzire abandu bakasyahera#Twamaleka ebibi byosi bya balimu babi,#Yesu angatulamya lino lino.##Inga tukole omubiri wa Yesu gho luba ;#Omwirimya akasyahika luba,#N’abandu bangi sibasi Omulamiya wetu#Tubirikire bo balame lino.

title: Buha Engubi
alias: Lift Up the Trumpet##CH 541-Doh is Ab
content: Buha engubi bosi bowe yo, Yesu akandisyasa ;#Neryo mwimbe banze n’obutseme : Yesu akandisyasa.##ERISUBA MO :#Asyahika, Asyahika,Omwami akasyasa.##Kangiriraya ehosi-hosi,  Yesu akandisyasa ;#Asyasa n’erihenia ering : Yesu akandisyasa.##Neryo buh’engubi omo ngetsi, Yesu akandisyasa ;#Buhir’engubi n’omo biharo: Yesu akandisyasa.##Neryo buh’engubi n’omo bitwa, Yesu akandisyasa ;#Emyatsi ikaghend’omwihunga : Yesu akandisyasa.##Linw’ebihanda byamatsurana, Yesu akandisyasa ;#Amenge amakanya uminye : Yesu akandisyasa.

title: Kirimu Kya Nyamuhanga
alias: Ewe Roho Wa Mbunguni N° 42 Sw.#(Spirit Dive, Attend Our Prayer)##CH  213 – Doh G
content: Kirimu kya Nyamuhanga, Wow’erisabe ryetu,#Wase wikale omw’itwe, Utusondolere.##Ng’omusakala w’engyakya, Uhighe omwirimya,#Tuminye ebibisire, N’obuholo bwawe.##Mo muliro, utweraye, Hisay’ebibi byetu,#Myeyo yetu yibye yawe, Kanisa y’Omwami.##Ngoko kime eky’engyakya, Humulaya abawe,#Mweyo oghumir’asyabya, N’emiyisa yawe.##Ng’erihunga Mwami wetu, Kiro kye Pentekoste,#Erilama ritulawe, Ko bihanda byosi.

title: Twasyahindana Elubula
alias: Shall We Gather##CH 555-Doh is Eb
content: Twasyahindan’élubula, Oko wetu ewa Yesu ;#Abandu ababiryanza, batsemire kutsibu-tsibu.##ERISUBA MO :#Twasyahindan’élubula, Oko lusi lubuya olw’engebe,#Bandu bosi batsemire eyo, Endambi syosi bane yo.##Baliyo bakimb’olwimbo, Obulighe sibuli yo ;#Olwimbo lwa Yesu Kristo, Omukama Munene wetu.##Esiseke sisiri yo, Omwirimya ahwere yo ;#Yesu Kristo ni Luseke Olwa bandu bosi abiwe.##Abayo bali n’amaka, Sibelwala n’erihola ;#Ebibi byosi byamahwa, Sibyangatok’eringira yo.

title: Byowene Eribya Haghuma
alias: Ni Heri Kifungo N° 47 Sw.#(Blest Be The Tie That Binds)##CH  432 – Doh F
content: Byowen’eribya haghuma, Mo lukoba ol’olwanzo,#Mweyo yetu mo lwanzo olowene:#Lwanzo lubuya lw’Abakrsito.##Embere sya Tata wetu, Tukakukam’erisaba,#Buba, maghaniryo maligho ghosi:#Ebyosi tukasangira byo.##Tukasangira ebyosi, Maligho, ebyagha byosi,#N’esindi ngendo tukalira-lira:#Misonia ey’obulighe.##N’endambi tukalaghana, Omo mweyo tukalira,#Tuwit’erikirirya eryoswire:#Twasyalolan’akw’elubula.

title: Mulamya Ngandikukwama
alias: I Will Follow Thee##CH 266-Doh is Ab
content: Mulamya ngandikukwama, Aho wanzire hosi ;#Aho ukaya ngukwame, Mwami ngandikukwama.##ERISUBA MO :#Mulamya ngandikukwa, wanyutir’omusasi#Wamabul’oyu kwanzire, Ingye ngandikukwama..##Nahw’enzira yamakingwa, Naho yamasendibwa ;#Mowalaba muyo kera, Ndabemo ngwit’ihenia.##Naho wamabya n’endwala, Ngalengwa ko kutsibu ;#Wabirirengwa ko nawe, Mwami ngandikukwama.##Wamandaby’omo bulighe, Lero namabya Mwera ;#Nawe mowabya Omwera, Naghe ngandikukwama.##Nomo wangananyitwala No omo mutobero ;#Nawe mowasoka utya, Naghe ngandikukwama.

title: Nyanzire Ekitabu Kiwe
alias: Napenda Kitabu Chake N° 62 Sw.#(I Love The Sacred Book of God)##CH  220 – Doh ....
content: Nyanzir’ekitabu Kiwe, Ekyo kyalwa elubula,#Nzakano kwingye y’Omwami, Bukwend’okw’ingye b’olwanzo.##Mwisi w’Ekitabu ekyo, Muli Obusu bwa Yesu,#Hipapuro hyabiribya, Musondoli waghe kundu.##Kinywa Kiw’ighery’ibuya, Ng’ekitondo eky’obuki,#Nyisondire erigherya oko Bundu  obw’Engebe.##Risonda ry’Omuhangiki, Rikabisulawa mukyo,#Endundi mbuya y’obwenge, Obuteke bw’eriswekya.##Kyakakala ky’ekihugho, Koleray’omo mutima,#Ubye Musondoli hosi, Luseke lw’ebika byaghe.

title: Hali Eyisoko Yoswire
alias: There Is A Fountain##CH 163-Doh is C
content: Hali eyisoko yoswire, N’omusasi wa Yesu Kristo ;#Oyo anzire erihenia, Angahika ku Yesu,#Asyalusibwa ko ebibi, N’engumbu y’enzira nyibi,#Oyo anzire erihenia, Angahika ku Yesu.##Itwe tunemutsema lingi, Twabiribana Omulamya ;#Ali n’akaghala kanene, K’erikinda Sitani.#Yesu mwakinda oluholo, Mwalubuka omwisinda,#Ali n’akaghala kanene, k’erikinda Sitani.##Oyo abirikw’oko muti, Akandisyahika akandi ;#N’erisyatutwala eghuwe, Ahate n’omulighe.#Tusikaye erina riwe, Tumuh’emitima yetu;#Tukandisyahika ewuwe, Ahate n’obiulighe.##Mwami nyinemukuhalya ko, Mba erikirirya ry’ekundu ;#N’omusasi wawe anyerye, Mba akalamu kawe,#Mba akalamu kawe Yesu mban’erilamibwa Nawe;#N’omusasi wawe anyerye, Mba akalamu kawe.

title: Kiro Kye Sabato
alias: Siku Ya Sabato N° 62 Sw.#(The Holy Sabbath Lord)##CH  470 – Doh ....
content: Kiro kye Sabato, Kibuyirire,#Bandu bawe Mwami, Banzire kyo kundu.##Mo wery’e Sabato, Mo watsumula yo,#Kiro ekyo kye Sabato, Kiro kyawe Mwami.##Natwe tutsumule, Tune mukuramya,#Omo kiro ky’obutseme, Kiro kyawe Mwami.##Nahaty’elubula : Haghuma n’Omwami,#Tukasond’iluhuk’e Sabato y’Omwami.

title: Nyihenaye Kwilab'amatwa
alias: Lord Jesus, I Long To Be Perfectly Whole##CH 592-Doh is A
content: Mwami Yesu nyanzire kunzondola#Nyanzire ubye mo mutima waghe#Inaleka erisaba esyisumba,#Unyeraye nyihenaye kwenene.##ERISUBA MO :#Nyihenaye kwilab’amatwa,#Umba eryera ngandikutsemesya.##Mwami undebay’ighune n’ewawe,#Mba eriher’obuhere bowene.#Butsira eritikatika nyiyihe#Unyeraye nyihenaye kwenene.##Yesu nyinemukulirira lino ;#Nyitoke erikulinda Mukama.#Unyuwanaye omo Musasi wawe,#Unyeraye nyihenaye kwenene.##Mulamya nyinemukulindirira ;#Yesu as’umbe omutim’owene#Suliwaghan’omundu n’omughuma,#Unyeraye nyihenaye kwenene.

title: Ebihya-bihya Ni Sonda Ry'omwami
alias: Mapya Ni Mapenzi Ya Mungu N° 90 Sw.#(New Every Morning)##C.S.  794 – Doh ....
content: Bihya n’isonda ry’Omwami, Engyakya tukalola ko,#Nomo kiro atuteya, Erihika okw’ibuka.##Biro byosi, bihya kw’itwe, Lukogho, bubuy’ikala,#Erilama, Righenyera, Bibuya omo butseme.##Twamayikandanga lino, N’emibere eyowene,#Nyamuhang’akatubwira, Ebikamutsemesaya.##Bindu byetu by’ekihugho, Mwami asyabitabala,#Omwagha asyahindulwa, Okw’itwe : Aby’emiyisa.##Ebiring’ebindu bike, Twamakoler’Omukama,#Tuminye ko twasyahembwa, Eno eka n’elubula.##Eh, Omwami biro byosi, Tuwatikay’omo byosi,#Mo lughendo lwetu losi, Lubye ngoko tukasaba.

title: Wowe Amakuta
alias: Hear The Pennies Dropping##CH 555-Doh is Eb
content: Ghowe amakuta, anemutogha ;#Ghosi ni wa Yesu, tumutekere.##ERISUBA MO :#Togha, togha, togha, togha amakut’ayo,#Ghosi ni wa Yesu, Tumutekere.##Akalw’omo byala, Anemutogha ;#Buhere bwa Yesu, Ko Bana buwe.##Lino tuli Bana, N’ekyo tuwite ;#Neryo twamakula, Tukandikanya.##Twamayira bike, Tubihy’Omwami ;#Asyangirira byo, Atulamaye.

title: Mulete Ezaka Y'omo Kighona
alias: Leteni Zaka Kwa Hazina N° 95 Sw.#(Bring Ye All th Tithes)##C.S.  239 – Doh ....
content: Mowe ekinywa kya Nyamuhanga wetu,#Mulet’Ezaka omo kighona.#Mulete ne emyeyo yenyu eyosi,#Emiyisa yasyabwagha.##ERISUBA MO:#Mulete Ezak’omo Kighona,#Ka uhirike omw’iteka.#Omwami asyakutsumula,#Kulenga ebyo wabirimusoha.##Wasonda Omutima Mubuyirire,#Ulet’Ezaka omo kighona,#Wikale hakuhi n’Omwami wawe,#Nikw’imo wasyatsumulwa.##Wabya n’akandu kabi n’Omwami wawe!#Ulet’Ezaka omo kighona.#Ulete syo ngok’Omwamy’alaghana#Nikw’imo wasyatsumulwa.##Usime Omwami mo myatsi yosi,#Ukalet’Ezak’omo Kighona.#Kiriraya ndaghane siwe syosi,#Nikw’imo wasyatsumulwa.##Twimb’itwe bosi syonyimbo sy’obutseme,#Tukalet’Ezak’omo kighona.#Twimbe kwenene n’obutseme bungi,#Kundi twamabitsumulwa.

title: Yesu Kristo Mwanyanza
alias: Jesus Loves Me##C.S. 283-Doh is Eb
content: Yesu Kristo mwanyanza, mwaliha olubanza ;#Ingye ndi mundu molo, Naye ni wa Kaghala.##ERISUBA MO :#Yesu anzire, abandu bosi,#Monzo ni Mwenge, Ekyo ni wasingya.##Yesu Kristo anzire, Imwe  ab’ekihugho ;#Kumbe mwamabinduka, Iniabah’erilama.##Yesu Kristo Mukama, Unyilamaya lino ;#Namaleka Sitani, N’ebibi byosi byaghe.##Yesu Kristo wasyasa, Wasyanyitwal’ewawe ;#Ngandikol’omubiri, Inakulindirira.

title: Bindu Byawe Mwami
alias: Mali Yako Sasa N° 96 Sw.#(We Give Thee But Thine Own)##C.S.  787 – Doh ....
content: Bindu byawe Mwami, Twamaletania kubyo,#Situwite oko byetu, Byosi ni luhabwa.##Itwe ngabakoli, Mwami utubuyire,#Twasyasubuliry’Omwami, Ebimutolere.##Utuwatikaye Eribya nal’olwanzo,#Baminy’Engul’abo abali omo mwirimya.##Kinywa kyawe Mwami, Tukiseghemerere,#N’ebyosi twakola, Bibye omw’isonda ryawe.

title: Weray'ebyala Byaghe
alias: I Washed My Hands##C.S. 569-Doh is Ab
content: Weray’ebyala byaghe, Byere kundu kundu ;#Ko nabiriha Yesu, Byangamukolera.##ERISUBA MO :#Sinendiy’ahandi, N’erimusigha,#N’erisiky’oghundi, Ni nawe Yesu.##Ndegh’amatwi n’eryowa, Nyikol’ébibuya ;#Ebyo ngowa ambwira, Bustir’italya byo.##Ngateghay’amaboko, Ebyo angakola ;#Ngunge kw’eryendererya, Akolere Yesu.

title: Monakuh'erilama
alias: Nilikupa Wewe N° 98 Sw.#(I Gave My Life For Thee)##CH  230 – Doh ....
content: Ingye ka monakuha, Musasi gh’omo mweyo,#Utoke erilama, Ulw’omo luholo.##ERISUBA MO 1:#Namatakwima ki we waghe?#Nawe wamatamba ki?#Namatakwima ki we waghe?#Nawe wamatamba ki?##Monakuh’obuyingo, Bwaghe mo kihugho,#Utok’erilamibwa, Wingir’elubula.##Namabikuletera, Omo kihugho kino,#Lwanzo n’Erilamibwa, Bikalw’elubula.##Umbe ebiro byawe, Nyikoleraye ndeke,#Mo maghali wawe, Nyiby’omo butseme.##ERISUBA MO 2:#Mweyo, mweyo, lwanzo, n’ebindu#Wimaye, Imanueli,#Mweyo, mweyo, lwanzo, n’ebindu#Wimaye, Imanueli.

title: Nyipipire Olwanzo
alias: ‘Tis Love That Makes Us Happy##C.S. 567-Doh is Bb
content: Nyipipire Olwanzo, Lolukanyibwira ;#Riyirira bandi ndeke, Bangaminya Yesu.##ERISUBA MO :#Tata we ingye mwana wawe,#Tata we ngukwamirire;#Nyipipire Olwanzo, Lolukanyibwira#Riyirira bandi ndeke, Bangaminya Yesu.##Ekihugho ky’ebibi, Buligh’erihola ;#Sibingaghe erikol’omubiri wa Yesu.##Byasyabya byabihwa ho, Twasyay’elubula ;#Twasyabya tukamupipa Omwami gh’olwanzo.

title: Tughende Eyiri Yesu
alias: Twende Kwa Yesu N° 99 Sw.#(Come to The Saviour, Make No Delay)##SS  1155 – Doh Bb
content: Tughende eyiri Yesu, Tusondolwe mo nzira mbuya,#Twasy’itwe bosi, Situlinde, Atulindirire.##ERISUBA MO :#Twasyabya n’obutseme bungi,#Myeyo yetu yabiryeribwa.#Egh’Omukama, twasyatsema#Ribya yo na kera.##Aban’abase, akabugha : Butseme oko bakamowa,#Niye Mulamya wetu kundu, Ka tumusikaye!##Ukalinda ki, Ane lino, Hulikirira akabugha;#Lukogho lukabirikira : Wase sighumbaye.

title: Tughende Abasirikani
alias: Onward Christian Soldiers##CH 360-Doh is E
content: Twend’abasirikani, Bandu b’Omwami ;#Yesu an’embere, Tumukwamire,#Tutwaly’omusalama, Atuby’embere,#Tukwamirir’eriyalwa tukind’Enzighu:##ERISUBA MO :#Tughende Abasirikani, Tuyalwe twe bose,,#Tughende na Yesu, Tukind’Enzighu.##Endeko sya Sitani, Syamakw’obuba ;#Syamowa Omwami, Isyatibita,#Obutseme bw’Ababuyirire kundu;#Banemupipa Omwami n’erimusima.##E Kanisa y’Omwami ine haghuma ;#Inemuhangana, Eriyakinda,#Siyendighabana ho, Erikirirya;#Erikangiriry’ighuma, Mwami Mughuma.##Sihaly’Amamy’atehwa, akandisyahwa ;#Neryo e Kanisa, Ikaksyakota,#Kulimu n’oluholo, Sibyesyakinda;#Kristo abirilaghana Syaliyiteba.##Neryo muyalwe bosi, Tutimbatimbe;#Twimbire haghuma, Mirenge yetu.#Tumwimbire, tusime, Omwami Yesu,#Warihenia lyeryubahwa, kwilaba bosi.

title: Iwe Wamaluha Kundu
alias: Wewe Umechoka Sana N° 112 Sw.#(Art You Weary, Art You languid?)##C.S.  104 – Doh .....
content: Wamaluha kundu, Wasonda riluhuka,#Ewa Yesu wasyabana obwiranda bosi.##Ebiminyikalo, Eby’esyongolu siwe,#Sy’ebyala biwe, na maghulu, n’olukanga!##Yesu abirimbalibw’Embita y’amahwa ;#Mbita kundu, mwambalibw’embita y’amahwa.##Erikwama Yesu Mwami ka ryasyamba ki ?#Ehihya n’emwisi waghe ka ni butseme.##Nasyamukwamirira Yesu, Biro byosi ;#Nasyingira omo butseme obwa kera.

title: Lebaya Sutebawe
alias: My Soul, Be On Thy Guard##CH 358-Doh is C
content: Lebaya sutebawe, Ebibi byatimba ;#Bikasa eritimba-timba, Mbusuy’elubula.##Lebay’iwe usabe, Sulwe omo malwa ;#Uhangan’ebiro byosi, Yes’akuwatikya.##Uwe suliwakinda, Susighe engabo ;#Lebay’amalw’asyahwa, Wasimya akakira.

title: Nyibye Nga We Yesu
alias: Niwe Kama Yesu N° 136 Sw.#(Teach Me Father)
content: Tata unyighisaye, Enzira y’erisaba,#Unzondolere kundu, Nyibye nga we Yesu.##ERISUBA MO :#Nyibye nga Yesu, Nyibye nga we Yesu,#Tata unzondolere, Nyibye nga we Yesu.##Umbe olwanzo, Tata, Lw’erilamya abandu,#Mo maka n’omo miyi, Nyibye nga we Yesu!##Utok’erinyighisya, Endambi ni nge kundu ;#Umb’omuhwa Mukama, Nyibye nga we Yesu.

title: Ibuk'omutima Wawe
alias: Awake My Soul##CH 355-Doh is G
content: Ibuk’omutima waghe, Sonda-sonda byowene ;#Ulw’amalwa aghowene, Wasyakokibwa yo.##Omukama akusonda, Ghenda luba witabe ;#Omukama asyahemba, Ababirikinda.##Endeko yikalebaya, Ikakulindirira ;#Siwibuke eby’ enyuma, Lol’embere syawe.##Mulamya wetu twanzire, Tukasingana kuwe ;#Twamasa erikupipa, Tunakusikirye.

title: Mwisi Gh'omusalama
alias: Chini Ya Msalaba N° 141 Sw.#(Beneath The Cross Of Jesus)##CH 350  -  Doh is Db
content: Mwisi gh’omusalaba, Ngasond’erimana,#Gho Lukuk’omo lughendo, Kitsutsu kibuya.#Kwenen’omutima waghe, Asyaluhuka ho,#Nasyiky’emiheke, Omughulo oyo.##Mwisi gh’omusalaba, Busayiro bwetu,#Aho hakalangirika, Eryanza kwenene!#Ngoko akanganibawa, Yakobo e kera,#Musalaba : kisambiro ky’elubula.##Yesu ko musalaba, Mo bamusosotya,#Mwahola nyilame ingye nabya nyiherire.#Ngalangira kundu kandi ebindu bibiri,#Ko mwanyanza ingye mundu ow’ebibi.##Oyo wasyalola ku Yesu Elubula,#Mwatsuka enzira yiwe y’oko musalaba.#Aho hohaly’erilama, Handi ka sihali!#Hasyaby’obutseme, Haghuma n’Omwami.

title: Nasa Ku Musalaba
alias: I Am Coming To The Cross##CH 600-Doh is G
content: Nasa ku musalaba, Nduhire, mwera, mumu ;#Sindisagha na hake, Ngasonda iwo wene.##ERISUBA MO :#Mwami indi n’amahga, Mulamya waghe Mwenge,#Nyikangy’embere syawe, Mwami Yesu, nyilamye.##Nayitsutsa We kera, Mo bulighe bw’ebibi ;#Yesu mwambwira ati: Asa, Ngakulamaye.##Lino nayihaghura, Sinyibuk’ekihugho ;#Mbye wawe, Mwami Yesu, Imay’ebyaghe byosi.##Ndi n’amaha w’ebyawe, Wanywutir’omusasi ;#Lino namayikangya, Indi ku Musalaba.##Nzemire namalama, Yesu kaghala kaghe;#Sindi ho n’ekitingu, Nyipipire Embuli.

title: Wimaye Eribyaho Ryaghe
alias: Twae Wangu Uzima N° 146 Sw.#(Take My Life and Let It Be)##AHR 363 – Doh is G
content: Twala engebe yaghe, Bihembo eby’erisima,#Twala endambi syaghe, Bikupipe Mwami waghe.##Twala ebyala byaghe, Bikole eby’ukasonda,#Twal’amaghulu waghe, Asondolawe n’Omwami!##Twal’omulenge waghe, Nyikwimbire Mwami waghe,#Twala n’eminywa yaghe, Yusule Ekinywa kyawe.##Twal’ezahabu yaghe, N’ebyosi eby’ekihugho,#Twala n’obwenge bwaghe, Kolesya byo ko wanzire.##Twal’amalengekania, Syabye waghe Mwami waghe,#Twal’omutima waghe, Wikale mo Mwami waghe.##Twal’erisonda ryaghe, Ripipa ry’omweyo waghe,#Twala engebe yaghe, Nyibye Wawe : Mwami, kundu.

title: Muyisa, Muyisa
alias: Lord, I Hear##CH 208-Doh is G
content: Mwami mb’Omuyisa wawe, Uhitaye gho busa ;#We Mulamya sundabe ko, Neryo mba Omuyisa.##ERISUBA MO :#Muyisa, Muyisa, Nery’umbe Omuyisa.##Sunzighe Tata Mubuya, Ebibi byamanduhya ;#Ndolere owerighuswa, Nikwa unyighenyere.##Namabulir’omo bibi, Namakuhitaniya ;#Namatimbwa n’ekihugho, Undusaye mo lino.##S’undabe ko Omukama, Nyiribule ameso ;#Unyiminyisaye Tata, Nzire eby’ekihugho.

title: Unzondole Yehova
alias: Niongoze Yehova N° 156 Sw.#(Lead Me O Thou Great jehovah)##CH 409 Doh is ......
content: Unzondolere Yahova, Ndi mughendi wa hisi,#Ndi molo, We gh’Obutokin Ngwaty’okuboko kwaghe.#Unzondole, undeghaye, Unganganay’enzira,#Unganganay’enzira mbuya,##N’ekitehero ky’engebe, Maghetsi w’erilamya,#Kingula omweyo waghe, Nganywe n’erilamibwa,#Nyinywesaye, nyilisaye, Nyitoke eryughuta,#Nyitoke eryughuta kwenene.##N’endambi ey’erisoka, Olusi lwe Yordani,#Bugh’obuba bwaghe bosi, Ndole ko busu bwawe.#Twasyimbir’ahw’esyonyimbo, Twasyapipa Omwami,#Twasyapipa Omwami wetu.

title: Nyusule
alias: Hover O’er Men Holy Spirit##CH 212-Doh is G
content: Kirimu Kibuyirire, Asa ngasibe nawe ;#Nyusul’omuyisa wawe, Asa, asa nyusule.##ERISUBA MO :#Nyusule, nyusule, Yesu asa nyusule;,#Nyusul’omuyisa wawe, Asa asa nyusule.##Wangatok’erinyusula, Nibya ingye sinyasi ;#Kirimu kya Nyamuhanga, Asa, asa nyusule.##Sinyikalir’indi molo, Nyinekunamira ;#Musibikya w’elubula, Mba olwanzo, nyusule.##Wase nyere kandi ndame, Luhukya Omutima ;#Niwe ukambumulaya, Unyusulaye lino.

title: Ane Ho, Ane Ho
alias: Yu Hai, Yu Hai N° 167Sw.#(He Lives, He Lives) ..................
content: Yesu, Mwami, Mulamya, Ali ho na kera,#Nasi ngokw’ane naghe, Emighulu yosi.#Ngow’omulenge wuwe, N’olukogho luwe,#Ndambi ngamulagha ko, Ali naghe.##ERISUBA MO :#Ane h’, Ane h’ Ane h’Mulamya Yesu,#Alendera, Akakania, nagh’ebiro byosi.#Ane h’, Ane h’, Kaleta engebe,#Nyasi Yesu ngokw’Ane ho: Aly’emwisi waghe.##Buteya bwawe bun’okw’ingy’ebiro byosi,#Maghulu amaluha, Sinangatw’amaha.#Nyasi kw’akanzondola, Mo bisunda byosi,#Nasyamulola ko e-kirw’asyasa.

title: Nyikwanzire Mwami
alias: I Need The Every Hour##CH 258-Doh is Ab
content: 1.	Nyikwanzire Mwami, Omulamya waghe ;#Omulenge wawe, Kalet’obuholo.##ERISUBA MO :#Mwitungi n’omo kiro, Nyikwanzire Mwami,#Unzumule Mulamya, Tusibe nawe.##2.	Nyikwanzire Mwami, Mbye hakuhi nawe ;#Ndok’ikind’enzighu, Ndi haghuma nawe.##3.	Nyikwanzire Mwami, Butseme, bulighe ;#Asa, lino-lino : Nyitok’eryeribwa.##4.	Nyikwanzire Mwami, Mbwir’ebyo wanzire ;#Unyibegheraye, Mukama, Mulamya.##5.	Nyikwanzire Mwami, Mwamy’owene kundu ;#Nzondole mbye wawe, Uwe Mutsumulwa.

title: Nyamuhanga Anzire
alias: Mungu, Mapenzi, Makamilifu N° 167Sw.#(O Perfect Love)##CH 416 Doh is ......
content: Mwami wanzire, Ryanza ry”ekwenene,#Rilabire obwenge bw’abandu.#Twamayikehya, Itwe banyabibi,#Uh’emiyisa, Abanze betu.##Uli n’olwanzo, Lute n’olulengo,#Twasabir’abanze betu bosi.#Uhe b’olwanzo, Luteyihanaya,#Baheruki baly’embere syawe.##Iwe engebe, kand’uli Kighona,#Ky’erikirirya, ribuya kundu.#Uh’ebo righum’omo myatsi yosi,#Mo mwagha ow’ekihugho kino.##Bah’obutseme, obute n’enduli,#Bubye olusek’omo malighe.#Bahy’obuholo, omo nyumba yabo,#Baby’omo bwiranda biro byosi.##Balol’embere, Omw’iwatikania,#Ribya ho ryabo omo kihugho.#N’oko nduli, Eryasa ly’Omulamya,#Batsemer’elubula na kera.

title: Nyikuh'ebyosi
alias: Al To Jesus, I Surrender##CH 573-Doh is D
content: 1.	Yesu mbye wawe, nyikokye, n’ebyaghe ngwite byosi ;#Nyikwanzire ngwikirirye, Ngukwame ndambi syosi.##ERISUBA MO :#Nyikuh’ebyosi, nyikuh’ebyosi,#Mulamya waghe Mubuya, Nyikuh’ebyosi.##2.	Yesu ndi wawe, nyikokye, Ingye muke ngusabe ;#Namughut’eby’ekihugho, Lino Yesu nyikokye.##3.	Yesu ndi wawe nyikokye, Mwami nyibye o wawe ;#Tum’Omusibiky’Ambwire, Ko nabiribya Wawe.##4.	Yesu nyikuhe ebyosi, Musibikya, Mutima ;#Nyipipe erighanyira, Ngusab’ebiro byosi.

title: Butseme Bwaghe, Mulamya
alias: Raha Yangu Yote, Bwana N° 190 Sw.#(For Ever Here My Rest Shall Be)##CH 416 Doh is ......
content: Butseme bwaghe Mulamya, Mo lukanga lwawe,#Sinyiyitayire ekindu, Wabirinyitongolya.##Mulamya iwe wahola, Uli Nyamuhanga,#Mowabugh’ebibi byaghe, Mo luholo lwawe.##Nyeraye nyibye nga matwa, Ubye Waghe hosi,#Unyeray’omo Musasi, Wawe nyibye wawe.##Unyeraye ehosi-hosi, Rihik’oko mano,#N’erihika oko mutwe, N’emwisi gh’omutima.##Bubye buhere obubuya, Ngakol’omubiri,#Rikirirya ryaghe rikanye, Nyikulole ko Mulamya.

title: Nyinemwasa Ko Ndi
alias: Just As I Am##CH 222-Doh is Eb
content: Lino nyinemwasa ko ndi, Mulamya, Ndamaye n’omusasi wawe ;#Nyitaby’omuleng’akambirikira : Ngasa, Mbuli ya Nyamuhanga.##Lino nyinemwasa ko ndi, Mulamya, Nyeray’omutima kw’ebibi ;#Uwe mweny’omusasi w’erilamya : Ngasa, Mbuli ya Nyamuhanga.##Nyinemwasa ebibi byamanduhya, Ngakindawa ebiro byosi ;#Hali bingi ebikanyitimba ko : Ngasa, Mbuli ya Nyamuhanga.##Lino nyinemwasa ngye ndi, Muhanya, ndi ne mumu, ndi na mutsiha ;#Ebyanganyerya ngabisung’ewawe : Ngasa, Mbuli ya Nyamuhanga.##Lino nyinemwasa Unyikokaye, Nyusulaye erikirirya ;#Nyitok’ikinda ebikandebaya : Ngasa, Mbuli ya Nyamuhanga.##Lino nyinemwasa, mba Lwanzo Lwawe, Iwambohol’omo miriki ;#Eritsuka lino namabya wawe : Ngasa, Mbuli ya Nyamuhanga..

title: Bundu Bw'elubula
alias: Mkate wa Mbingu N° 191 Sw.#(Break Thou The Bread Of Life) CH 41
content: Bundu bw’elubula, Bundu bwetu,#Obo wah’Abigha bawe bosi.#Rilw’omo Kitabu, Tukasoma,#Omutim’akanza ribya h’uli.##Kinywa ky’Ekwenene, Kitsumule,#Twowe eribirikira ryawe.#Emikangi yosi, Yasyahwa ho,#Neryo twasyatsem’ebiro byosi.##Engebe, Kaghala : Watekire:#Ngaghend’embere erikukwama.#Ingye indi molo, Ndi w’ebibi,#Iwe w’Erikinda, Ubye naghe.

title: Mwami Ni Mwenge
alias: We Praise Thee O Lord##C.S. 396-Doh is G
content: Mwami ni Mwenge, ka mwatuma Yesu ;#N’eritulamya lino mo nzira nyibi.##ERISUBA MO :#Haleluya tumukwame, Haleluya kundu,#Haleluya Yesu Kristo, Utulamaye.##Tuyire Yesu, Munene ng’Omwami ;#Kusangw’abirihola n’eritulamya.##Utusulaye, no Lwanzo lo Lwawe ;#N’obuteseme bunene, Bw’ebiro vyosi.##Tulek’ebindu, By’ekihugho kino ;#Tukwame Yesu Kristo Mukama wetu.##Tuhe omuhwa, Tusulaye kundu ;#Omundu mundu, Akwanze kundu kundu.

title: Lukuka Lw'e Kanisa
alias: Msingi Wa Kanisa N° 195 Sw.#(The Church Has One Foubdation)##CH 433 - Doh is ......
content: Lukuka lwe Kanisa, Ni Yesu Mukama,#Kihangikwa kiwe kihy’anzire kyo kundu.#Mwalwa omo lubula, Erisyasondya kyo,#Mwaligha erihol’oko muty’e Kalwari.##E Kanisa yiri mo Ebihanda byosi,#Rilama ryayo niry’Omulamya mughuma.#Bubuti ni bughuma, Yiketer’ighuma,#Ekyalya ni kighuma, Yiketer’ighuma.##Bandu ka baswekire, Isweka ni ringi,#Ko bikasir’eyihya, N’ebikasira mo,#Ababuyire bakasaba butumbya,#Mo kiro ni kiriro, Engyakya butseme.##Amalwa n’eryaghalwa, Byamatuhikira,#Situtw’amaha wetu, Tulolay’embere.#Olukengerwa luwe, Twasyalangira lo,#Kanisa yasyakinda, Yasyabya ho kera.

title: Ngasonda Eryera
alias: Take Time To Be Holy##CH 603-Doh is F
content: Ngasonde eryera, Saba suluhe,#Usibe n’Omwami, Umusikaye;#Wanze Abakristo, Lamy’Abakoni,#Siwibirirawe, Erimusaba.##Ngasonde eryera, Bungi bw’ebibi,#Usibe na Yesu, Ahabisire ;#Umusamalire, Wasyabya nga Ye,#Bosi basyaminya, Kumusosire.##Ngasonde eryera, Akusondole,#Eriyibombeka embere siwe,#Ko wanabya kosi, Wasyamubwira;#Usikaye Yesu, Umowe lino.##Ngasonde eryra, Kungo’omutima,#Lengekania ndeke, Suyire luba;#Wowe Musibikya, Ubye n’olwanzo,#Wasyatunganana, Riy’elubula.

title: Tata Wetu Iw'uly'elubula
alias: Baba Yesu Aliye Mbinguni N° 200 Sw.#(I Am So Glad That ...)##CH 423 – Doh is
content: Tata wetu iw’uly’elubula,#Wamabitutsemesya kwenene.#Eritubwira eby’Amasako,#Uli netu omo Lwanzo lwawe.##ERISUBA MO :#Anyanzire Mulamya Yesu,#Anyanzire, Anyanzire,#Anyanzire Mulamya Yesu,#Anyanzire, Ingye.##Namamuleka, N’ eriya hali,#Kwali ngo kwali, Akanza kundu.#Akanzubay’ewuwe mo lwanzo,#Yesu ane naghe omo lwanzo.##Anyanzire naghe nyimwanzire,#Yesu Kristo abirindongolya.#Mwanyiholer’oko musalaba,#Yesu ane naghe omo lwanzo.

title: Ubye Netu
alias: Abide With Us##CH 50-Doh is Eb
content: Ubye netu n’akaghala kwe,#Netu sitwangubaha Sitani,#Mo mwirimya w’ekihugho kino,#Wangabya luseke lwetu, Kristo.##Ubye netu n’erihenia lyawe,#Biro ni bike eby’ekihugho,#N’Abandu bangabindu luba,#Uwe w’Erikota, Ubye netu.##Unye netu emighulu yosi,#Nindi angatulamya kw’ebibi?#Nindi angatuhangania nga We?#Tukayiketera We Mukama.##Ubye netu, Tata w’Erikota ;#Tughaniray’oluholo lwawe,#Tukulinde k’omubiri wawe,#Yesu Mulamiya, ubye netu.

title: Eribya Na Yesu Omo Nyumba
alias: Kuwa na Yesu Nyumbani N° 204 Sw.#(Happy, Happy Home)
content: Ribya na Yesu mo nyumba, Butseme bungi;#Butseme bungi; Butseme bungi,#Ribya na Yesu mo nyumba,#Butseme bungi; Butseme bungi.##Yesu amaby’omo Tata, Buholo bungi,#Buholo bungi, Buholo bungi,#Yesu amaby’omo Tata,#Buholo bungi, Buholo bungi.##Yesu amaby’omo Koyo, Buholo bungi,#Buholo bungi, Buholo bungi,#Yesu amaby’omo Koyo,#Buholo bungi, Buholo bungi.##Yesu amaby’omo Bana, Buholo bungi,#Buholo bungi, Buholo bungi,#Yesu amaby’omo Bana,#Buholo bungi, Buholo bungi.

title: Ulangire Bwamira
alias: Day Is Dying In The West##CH 51-Doh is Ab
content: Ulangire bwamira, Bwirire, tuluhuke ;#Ebyakakala by’ekiro, Byaka tusabe Omwami, Itwe bosi.##ERISUBA MO :#Mwenge, Mwenge, Mwenge : Mwami Yesu,#Wayitsungany’ehosi, Byosi bikakupipa : Nyamuhanga.##Omwami gho Buyingo, Hindany’abakwanzire ;#Ubusulaye olwanzo, Ubabindule mo bawe : Bakupipe.##Omwirimya akanya, Tukingir’ighenyera ;#Tukutwalir’emitima yetu, omo Bwami bwawe : Nyamuhanga.##Utuh’erikirirya, Twasyahola Mukama ;#Twasyabana kyakakala, N’omwirimya asyahwa ho: Tukupipe.

title: Mo Mutima
alias: Moyoni N° 211 Sw, N° 400 NZK (450).#(Into My Heart)
content: Mo mutima, Mo mutima,#Yesu uby’omo mutima.#Asa lino, na wikale,#Wingir’omo mweyo, Mwami.#Mo mutima, Mo mutima,#Koleraya omutima,#Koleraya munabwire;#Koleraya omutima.###031. SALAMR’OMWAMI WAWE#Mtazame Mwokozi N° 212 Sw, N° 137 NZK (450).#(Turn Your Eyes Upon Jesus)##Erisuba mo :#Samalir’Omwami wawe,#Yihir’omo byala biwe.#Akandisyakuh’obuholo,#Omw’ibya ho eryawe ryosi.

title: Lyuba Ly'omutima
alias: Sun of My Soul##CH 321-Doh is F
content: Omulamya Lyuba ly’Omutima ;#Omwirimya syahika ewuwe,#Wamabya hakuhi mwami,#Sinendisyubaha na hake.##Omughulu w’eriyaghotsera,#Ngaluhuka emibiri yosi.#Umb’erikulengekania,#Ngotser’indi haghuma nawe.##Undind’omo kiro no mwitungi ;#Sinangatoka tute haghuma,#Undinde omo malighe,#Kusangwa singwite amaka.##Omughulu nyinemwendibuka ;#Na ho ngandiya eriyakola,#Omo kiro no mwitungi#Kusangwa Iwe kyakakala.

title: Yesu Niwe Ribwe
alias: The Lord’s Our Rock##CH 505-Doh is F
content: Yesu niwe Ribwe ryetu, Obuwamo bw’eritsuku ;#Niw’utulamya malighe, N’obuwamo bw’eritsuku.##ERISUBA MO :#Ribwe, busayiro bw’abandu, Kitsutsu ky’eriluhukira;#Musondoli, Utetalaya, Obuwamo bw’eritsuku.##Anyilamya omwaghalwa, N’obuwamo bw’eritsuku ;#Tuli nawe sindyubaha, N’obuwamo bw’eritsuku.##Emigheri yamasenda, N’obuwamo bw’eritsuku ;#N’Omulamya wetu kundu, N’obuwamo bw’eritsuku.##Ribwe kundu, ry’erilamya, N’obuwamo bw’eritsuku ;#Tuwatikye mo malighe, N’obuwamo bw’eritsuku.

title: Saba Ndambi Syosi
alias: Omba Sana Asubui N° 212 Sw, N° 273 NZK (450).#(Whisper a Prayer In The Morning)
content: Saba omo ngyakyangyakya,#Saba kundu mw’itungi.#Saba kundu n’omw’igholo,#Mwami asyakowa.##Mwamy’akowa erisaba,#Mwangyakya n’omw’itungi.#Anemutulindirira,#Omw’igholo ryosi.##Twimbe omo ngyakya-ngyakya,#N’omo ndambi y’eritungi.#Tutseme haghuma Naye,#Tuluhuke Naye.

title: Akanzondola
alias: He Leadeth Me##CH 393-Doh is D
content: Nyitsemire Omulamya, Akangung’omo Binywa biwe ;#Aho ngaya n’erikola, N’okuboko kwa Yesu kunzondole.##ERISUBA MO :#Nyitsemire akanzondola, Yesu Musondoli w’ekwenene,#Nyanzire erimukolera, N’okuboko kwa Yesu kunzondole.##Namabya ndi mo bulighe, Kutse nyitsemire kutsibu ;#Mo buholo, n’eryaghalwa, N’okuboko kwa Yesu kunzondole.##Mwami nyanzire tusibe Nawe sinyiyitonge-tonge ;#Nyibye n’obutseme kundu, N’okuboko kwa Yesu kunzondole.##Mibiri yaghe yamahwa, Nginde omwighenyera lyawe ;#Sindyubaha n’oluholo, N’okuboko kwa Yesu kunzondole.

title: Ndi N'obuholo Mo Mutima
alias: When Peace Like A River##CH 31-Doh is E
content: Nyanzir’obuholo bombomba ng’olusi, Naho nabya n’obulighe ;#Ko nyiri kosi nyanzir’éribugha: Ndi n’obuholo mo mutima.##ERISUBA MO :#Buholo, Bubuya, Ndi n’obuholo mo mutima.##Sitani andebya ngabya n’obuhanua, Ngwity’amaha w’eriminya ;#Nikwa Kristo mwasunga ko ndi molo, Kyatuma iniut’omusasi.##Nzemire kutsibu, nabiribuyirwa, Sihasigher’ekighuma ;#Mobyabambwa nawe ko Musalaba, Mutima waghe sim’Omwami.##Mwami Yesu kiro wasyas’eritwenda,  Kirw’ebitu byasyalundwa ;#Engub’ibughe, Omwamy’andaghale, Ndi n’obuholo mo mutima.

title: Nyanziry'obwira
alias: What a Fellowship##CH 611-Doh is A
content: Nyanzir’obwira b’omo lubula, N’amaboko waw’erikota ;#Nzemire kundu, nyinasikire, N’amaboko waw’erikota.##ERISUBA MO :#Ndame, Ndama, N’amaboko waw’erikota,#Ndame, Ndama, N’amaboko waw’erikota.##Nzemire ko Yesu anzondola,  N’amaboko waw’erikota;#Nzungir’amaka atunganene, N’amaboko waw’erikota.##Singwire buba, Nyinasikire, N’amaboko waw’erikota ;#Namahehera, Nyitunganene, N’amaboko waw’erikota.

title: Namakwikirirya
alias: My Faith Looks Up To Thee##CH 246-Doh is Eb
content: Namakwikirirya, Mbuli ye Kalwari : We Mulamya;#ngusabe unyowe,#Ndamaye kw’ebibi:#Eritsuka lino, ngukwamire.##Nyusul’ighenyera, mba mbita yowene: Mba omuhwa#Ko wanyiholera,#Ngukangay’olwanzo;#Lutehwa lukaka ng’omuliro.##Bibi byamatimba, ngayir’obulighe : Unzondole,#Ndusy’omo mwirimya,#Ndusaye kw’ebibi;#Kandi sundekere hali  Kuwe.

title: Mbye Hakuhi Nawe
alias: Nearer My God To Thee##CH 382-Doh is G
content: Mbye hakuhi nawe, Mwami wetu,#Mo nangahanikwa ko Musalaba ;#Nabya nyinemwimba, Mbye hakuhi Mwami,#Mbye hakuhi Mwami, Nyibye hakuhi.##Mbye hakuhi nawe Mwami wetu,#Mo Malighe ghosi, Umbanganire.#Yesu twikalaye, Tuh’erisasira,#Mbye hakuhi Mwami, Nyibye hakuhi.##Mbye hakuhi nawe, Mwami wetu ;#Unyihanganire ebiro byosi.#Enzighu yamasa, Unyibwire Mwami,#Mbye hakuhi Mwami, Nyibye hakuhi.##Mbye hakuhi nawe, Mwami wetu ;#Wabirikingula, Omo lubula,#Mulikyetu sika, Ukandilamibwa,#Mbye hakuhi Mwami, Nyibye hakuhi.

title: Tukasikira Ku Kristo Olukuka
alias: Firmly Stand For God##CH 509-Doh is Eb
content: Iwe ghuyitsinge sighuluwe, Nomo wangowa ebikalire ;#Wasyahanganibwa n’Olukuka, Twamatimbwa n’ebibi.##ERISUBA MO :#Tukasikira ku Kristo Olukuka,#We Lukuka tweghemere,#Tubye n’obuholo, n’erisasira:#Muliro wa Nyamuhanga.##Yitsinge by’unasikire, Hatikana bya n’erikirirya ;#Lukuka lukatuh’erikinda, Muna kihugho ky’ebibi.##Yitsinge kundu binatolere, Sighumbaye wasyahabw’isimi,#Lukuka lukatuh’obuholo, Twabikind’ebibi byosi.

title: Nasyabya Nyinikirirye
alias: My Hope is Built##CH 581-Doh is G
content: Nasyabya nyinikirirye, Musasi gh’Omulamya,#Sinendisyakwama ghundi, Nina Yesu Iyo wene.##ERISUBA MO :#Kuwe Yesu namimana,#Nikwa handi ni museghe,#Nikwa handi ni museghe.##Omwirimy anyiribya, Yesu niw’erighenyera;#Mo Malighe n’obuhanya, Syendisyatusighania.##Nyeribawe mo Musasi, Yo wamba erimukwama ;#Nangabya omo bulighe, Akangwatiky’inyanzikya.##Inyasyasa ngo mulenge, Ow’Engunga yisikire ;#Nyambal’eritunganene, Sinendibya n’ekitingu.

title: Mwikirirye, Musikaye
alias: Trsut And Obey##CH 582-Doh is F
content: Twikale n’Omwami, Twowe ekinyw’ekyo, atuhir’omo nzira mbuya,#Tusikaye kundu, Akikale netu, n’abamwikirirye abosi.##ERISUBA MO :#Musikaye, sihali erindi  ilama, Yesu musa, Mwikirirye kundu,##Sihali nzukula, bitu bihindane, Amaseka ibyaseghera;#Sihali n’obuba, kutse n’eryubaha, Bikahwa twamamwikirirya.##Sitwendighalibwa, kutse n’obulighe, Niw’utuhembula kutsibu ;#Sihali obwera, sihali ryaghalwa, Twasyatsumulwa twamasikya.##Sitwangayitsutsa, Riyir’obutseme, Twabirek’ebibi byosi ;#Kw’ighenyera Liwe, Hitya ahitaye, N’isimi ry’Ababuyirire.##Twasyatsemerayo, Haghuma n’Omwami, Twasyabya Naye n’erikota ;#Tusikaye kundu, Asyabyatutuma, Sitwendisyubaha na hake.

title: Yesu Abye Nawe Ehosi
alias: God Be With You##CH 35-Doh is D
content: Yesu abye nawe ehosi, Neryo twikale haghuma,#Akalembera n’amenge, Yesu abye nawe ehosi.##ERISUBA MO :#Ekiro twasyahindana yo,#Twasyabya haghuma na Yesu,#Ekiro twasyahindana yo,#Yesu abye nawe ehosi.##Yesu abye nawe ehosi, Akulind’omo malighe,#Asyakulembera kundu, Yesu abye nawe ehosi.##Yesu abye nawe ehosi, No ko ndambi y’amalighe,#Akuwaty’oko kuboko, Yesu abye nawe ehosi.##Yesu abye nawe ehosi, Asyakutsumula kundu,#Abatulîre enzîra, Yesu abye nawe ehosi.

title: Twamikala N'abira
alias: With Friends On Earth##C.S. 866-Doh is Bb
content: Twamikala n’abira betu sitwendikw’engitsi,#Nikwa twamabighabana, Tukabya n’obulighe.##ERISUBA MO :#Kihugho sitweghabana,#Twasabya haghuma#Mo Kihugho ky’Obuholo,#Sitwandighabana.##Twamibuka abira betu, Tukatsema kundu,#Twasyabugh’emibiri yetu, Twasyakotera yo.##Sitwendisya-swalaghana yo, Twahik’elubula#Twasyaban’eritsema ringi, Twimbe ndambi syosi.

title: Rihol'emwisi Wa Yesu
alias: Asleep In Jesus##CH 489-Doh is D
content: Rihol’emwisi wa Yesu,#Oko Babuya niya to;#Sibebuka n’eririra,#Eyo sibangatebibwa.##Eriya to omu Yesu,#Ni Buluhuke bubuya.#Ni butseme bw’abamwasi,#Ko basyahabwa engebe.##Eriya to omu Yesu,#N’eribukibwa mo Naye,#N’akaghala k’Omulamya,#Sikekindwa n’oluholo.##Eriya to omu Yesu,#Bakasyowa omulenge,#Asisinda syakingulwa,#Abuwe bosi balame

title: Omughulu Mubîrî Waghe Ahwere
alias: When My Life Work Is Ended##C.S. 849-Doh is Ab
content: Omughulu mubiri waghe ahwere hano,#Ngandihike elubula habuya,#Nasyamuminya Omutongolya waghe luba#N’akandisyatsuka erinyikokya.##ERISUBA MO :#Nasyaminya Yesu Kristo,#Kusangwa abirinyitongolya,#Nasyaminya Yesu Kristo,#N’esyongolu omo byala biwe.##Abakristo bangi, baghendire emuliro,#Bakatulinda n’obuholo buwe;#Twasyatsema haghuma emuliro wa Yesu#Nikwa nyanzire Mukama ko bosi.##Nganditsema erilangira obusu buwe,#N’olwanzo luli oko meso wuwe.#Ngandisyamupipa busana n’olwanzo luwe#N’obwenge buwe bwabirinyilamya.

title: Umbe Biblia
alias: Give Me The Bible##CH 655-Doh is Ab
content: Umbe Bibliya yo yikanzemesya,#Unyisondolere muyo Mwami,#Ekyakakala kyayo sikyerima,#Ko Yesu mwasa eritowisya.##ERISUBA MO :#Umbe Bibliya yo yikanzemesya,#Nzondolwe nay’omo nzira nyike#Amatehgeko wayo gho mabuya,#Akaminyisay’enzira kundu.##Umbe Bibliya mo malighe waghe,#Omughulu ngatimwa n’ebibi,#Umb’ebinywa ebyo Yesu abugha,#Nikwa yowen’akambumulaya.##Umbe Bibliy’ingoleraye kundu,#Kand’indind’ebitegho by’ahisi,#Lo Luseke lukak’omo mwirimya,#‘Lwakangya enzira y’obuholo.##Umbe Bibliy’imbwir’eby’obuyingo,#Kandi Utusibikaye muyo,#Tuminy’enzira ikay’elubula,#Tulol’okwihenia lyawe Tata.

title: Ebinywa By'engebe
alias: Sing Them Over Again##CH 574-Doh is G
content: Akandi wanganyibwira, Ebinywa eby’engebe,#Ebisihire kwenene, Ebinywa by’engebe;#Ebinywa bilabire, Ebyosi eby’abandu.##ERISUBA MO :#Ni by’engebe, ni by’engebe,#Ebinywa bya Yesu Kristo#Ni by’engebe, ni by’engebe#Ebinywa bya Yesu.##Kristo abiriha bose, Ebinywa eby’engebe,#Akabirikira lino, Omundu w’ebibi#Akakuha buyira, butsira erighula.##Engulu Yowene Yiwe, Ebinywa eby’engebe#Bikaleta obuholo, Wamamwikiriya,#Oghundi wangalamya, Sihali no mughuma.

title: Oko Musike W'e Yorodani
alias: On Jordan’s Stormy Banks##CH 553-Doh is G
content: Indy’oko musike w’e Yordani, Nasumba ameso,#Ndangir’ekihugho kye Kanani, Aho ho byaghe biri.##ERISUBA MO :#Kihugho kibuya ky’obuholo,#Yisiry’oko musike aboyire,#Twasyimbira ho esyonyimbo sya Musa;#Eribya na Yesu Kristo.##Eyisiry’oko mukokoro, Hali ekyakakala,#Yesu Kristo asyaby’ekyakaka kyahighahw’ekiro.##Aho howene nasyahikey’ekiro kyahi kwehi,#Nasyalangira Tat’omo meso, omo Bwami buwe.##Nyitsemire omo mutima, Sinyanzir’eryubaha,#Yorodani ikahuha ndeke, Sindyubah’erisoka.

title: Hasyaby'obutseme
alias: O There’ll Be Joy##C.S. 553-Doh is C
content: Twasyatsem’emibiri yahwa, Abakaghesera Yesu,#Bakandisyiky’emiheke, E Yerusalem’eyo.##ERISUBA MO :#Butseme hasyaby’obutseme,#Sibwesyahwa kera na kera.#Obutseme buli hakuhi,#Tuhindanir’ewetu.##Twasyatsema n’erimwimbira, Twasyabya tupipe Yesu,#Rimusima, rimupipa, E Yérusalem’eyo.##Twasyatsemera yo kutsibu, Omo syonyumba nyibuya,#Yesu abirikokotya E Yerusalem’eyo.

title: Eyo Hakuhi
alias: One Sweetly Siemn Thought##CH 352-Doh is Bb
content: Namalengekania, Ewetu ni hakuhi,#Namaseghera elubula, Ni hakuhi kutsibu.##ERISUBA MO :#Eyo hakuhi ni hakuhi,#Lino ndi hakuhi ye wetu;#Nyinemwendihika yo.##Omo ngonde sya Tata, Hane yo esyonyumba#Syabirihimbwa kera kera, Ew’Ababuyirire.##Nasyabya ndi hakuhi, Nasyikya emiheke,#Nasyaluhuka omwaghalwa, Nambala erihenia.

title: Iri Ekihugho Kyowene
alias: There Is A Land##CH 551-Doh is G
content: Iri ekihugho kwowene, Ekya Tata wetu Mubuya#Anemukokotya ho wetu, Twasyasiba naye buholo.##ERISUBA MO :#Twasyahika bolo, Oko Muyi wa Tata wetu,#Twasyahindana yo, Oko Muyi mubuya kundu.##Twasyimba oko Muyi oyo, Esyonyimbo sya Yesu Kristo,#Ahate n’obulighe buke, Kutse erilwala amakoni.##Wasingya ko Mukama Yesu, Oyo watuholera kera,#Wasingya ko Mulamya wetu, Oyo watulusya kw’ebibi.

title: Tubatisaye
alias: Baptize Us Anew##CH 525-Doh is Ab
content: Tubatisaye omo Kirimu,#Mulamya as’eno, Tuhe Olwanzo.##ERISUBA MO 1 :#Lino Mwami Yesu twakulakira,#Muka Abuyirire, Tuhe olwanzo.##Tunemulaka, Tulame lino,#Tughenyere kundu, Twitwa n’ebibi.##Muka wa Yesu, Twandaghalire,#Tutsumule kundu, Tuh’Omuyisa.##Mulengy’uwene, Abugha ati:#Uli Mwanga waghe, Nyanzire kundu.##ERISUBA MO 2 :#Tunemukusima, N’erikupipa#Tukakuh’ewasignya, Mwami: Amina.

title: Asa Soko Y'omuyisa
alias: Come Thou Fount##CH 291-Doh is Eb
content: Asa soko y’omuytisa, mb’omutima ng’usime,#Esyonyusi esyituma, Twasyakupipa kundu.#Nyighisaye, risyakupipa, Nyiminy’ihenia lyawe,#Rikiriry’Obwami bwawe, Rikanyitsemesaya.##Nyisoghe mbye wawe kundu, Ndi ho busana nawe,#Nyasi ko washanyitwala, Mbik’ewawe buholo.#Yesu mwanzond’inyiherire, Nabya haly’omo bibi,#Asonda ndame luholo, Mwatek’engebe Yiwe.##Ndi mo mwinda wawe Mwami, busana n’olukogho,#Nyihire hakuhi nawe, nyiminy’olwanzo lwawe.#Ndimbwe ko n’ebikandenga ko, Sinangakusighania:#Imay’omutima waghe, Undinde ndame kundu.

title: Kirimu Kibuyirire
alias: Holy, Spirit, Faithfully Guide##CH 211-Doh is G
content: Kirimu Kibuyirire, Bya hakuhi n’Abakristo,#Ngwaty’okuboko nzondole, Ndi mughendi w’emusitu.#Abaluhire batseme, Bow’omulengy’owene,#Abwira bo batah’imwe, Mwase ngabatwaly’ewenyu.##Siwendisyatuhemula, Sulighan’eriwatikya,#Tubye ne erikirirya, Omo malighe tukwanze.#Amalighe amahika, Emitima yubaha,#Mulengy’ati: Batah’imwe: Mwase ngabatwaly’ewenyu.##Mibiri yetu yasyahwa, Twalindirir’érilama,#Twibulaye ko tuliyo, Mo Bitabu by’elubula.#Twisukul’ebikatebye, N’erikirirya Yesu,#Mulengy’ati: Batah’imwe: Mwase ngabatwaly’ewenyu.

title: Haly'ekyo Ngasaba Mwami
alias: One Thing Of The Lord##CH 634-Doh is Bb
content: Haly’eko ngasaba, Mwami!#Nomonangakola ebibi,#Unyeraya, Unyeraye,#Maghetsi, kuts’omuliro.##ERISUBA MO  :#Nyeribawe, kundu Mwami,#N’omuliro wamasonda#Ngus’ebibi, byaheribwa,#Biheribwe, Biheribye.##Wamatunganany’obwenge,#Nasyatsema n’erikupipa.#Nikwa omutima ere,#Alabire, Alabire.##Namer’omutima waghe,#Niho mo nasyabya n’amenge,#Ngangibawe, wawe Mwami:#W’elubula, w’elubula.##Ngayiteghaya ko bibi,#N’omo malangekania waghe,#Mwami, n’ebyongola byosi,#Sindi era, sindi era.

title: Suliwahika Ku Yesu Mulamya
alias: Have You Been Too Jesus?##CH 88-Doh is Ab
content: Suliwahika ku yesu Mulamya? Suliwaheny’omo musasi?#Wabirikirirya erina liwe? Omutima wawe erine?##ERISUBA MO  :#Mutima erire, erire mo musasi wuwe,#Wabirikirya ku Yesu Kristo,#Werire mo musasi wuwe.##Unemuhangana mo nzira yiwe, Omutima wawe erire?#Unemukwam’enzira ye Kalwari, Mukama abirilughula?##Unemusaba n’omuhwa munene, Omutima wawe erire?#Unemutula Engulu Yowene, N’omutima wawe erire?##Unemulinda Omukama Yesu, N’omutima wawe erire?#Wabirereka enzira y’ebibi, Omutima wawe erire?

title: Natalire Hali Ku Yesu
alias: I’ve Wandered Far Away##CH 560 - Doh is A
content: Natalire hali ku Yesu, Lino namasa,#Nabiribulir’omo bibi, Lero namasa.##ERISUBA MO  :#Nyireke, nyireke, Namabitsira,#Ntirighe unyibuyire, Mwami nyikokye.##Naherir’ebirimo bingi, Lino namasa,#Namayireta nyilamaye, Lero namasa.##Nduhir’omo bibi n’eriwa, Lino namasa,#Mbye n’amaha w’olwanzo lwawe, Lero namasa.##Yesu mwanyutir’omusasi, Lino namasa,#Iyo wene wanganyilamya, Lero namasa.##Ow’engitsi yaghe nyilame, Lino namasa,#Nyera Mwami mbye ng’amatwa, Lero namasa.

title: Oyo Anzire Ase
alias: Whoseover Hearth?##Doh is D  (Joyfully)
content: Yesu atwanzire kwilaba bose, Mwakwa oko muti n’eritulamya,#Mwaheka ebibi by’abandu bosi, Ekyo ni kya wasingya.##ERISUBA MO  :#Oyo anzire, ase ku Yesu, Asyaban’engebe yo y’erikota;#Oyo amawira, amakw’enyota, Angahika ku Yesu.##Birikir’abandu balwe kw’ebibi, Baleke enzira y’erisyahera,#Bahike ku Yesu yo Mulamiya, Oyo anzire ase.##Neryo sinangalinda mulikyetu, Luyi lw’elubula lukingukere,#Yesu ni nzira yo twangakwamire, Nawe wangingira mo.

title: Yo Mwami Wa Bosi
alias: All Hail The Power##CH 156-Doh is G
content: S’inga Mwami w’Erikota , Bosi bakusabe,#Mulet’embita y’Obwamo buwe, Aby’Omwamo w’abosi,#Mulet’embita y’Obwamo buwe, Aby’Omwamo w’abosi.##Mwe Banze be Israeli, Mwe bangu, mwe bake,#Musabe Oyo wabalamaya, Aby’Omwami w’abosi,#Musabe Oyo wabalamaya, Aby’Omwami w’abosi.##Bihanda byosi by’ahisi, N’ebitunga byosi,#Bosi babye banamusikirye, Aby’Omwami w’abosi,#Bosi babye banamusikirye, Kwali Yo Mwami w’abosi.##Lero tumwimbire kundu, Tumukukamire,#Tumupipe ne erimusima, Aby’Omwami w’abosi,#Tumupipe ne erimusima, Kwali Yo Mwami w’abosi.

title: Yesu Kristo Atwanza
alias: Jesus Lover Of My Soul##CH 401-Doh is F
content: Yesu Kristo watwanza, Uli Mulamya wetu,#Sitani syatwanzire, Akatukola nabi,#Yesu Kristo, twamasa, Oko wawe wowene,#Utulamaye lino, N’omusasi owene.##Yesu Kristo Mulamya, Watusondire kera;#Twamabya bandu babi, Utulusye kw’ebibi.#Utubise ho ghu, Ahate n’obulighe,#Situwite kaghala, Twamasa utuhe ko.##Engebe y’erikota, Yikalwa oko wawe,#Utusulaye lino, N’omutima mubuya.#Yesu twamakukwama, Utukangaye ndeke,#Twamalek’ekihugho, Tukwanze biro byosi.##Mukama mo wanyerya, No omusasi wawe,#No olukogho lwawe, Lukabanika kuwe.#Kuwe Mwami ngasunga, Engebe y’erikota,#Omo mutima waghe, Mukama unyusule.

title: Yesu Tutsemesaye
alias: Jesus, Thou Joy Of Loving Heart##CH 154-Doh is A
content: Yesu tutsemesye itwe, Soko y’engebe kyakakala ky’abandu,#Eritsema lyosi ly’ashisi, Tulitsire n’erikukwamirira.##Obundu bw’engebe niwe, Tusond’erighulwa nawe biro byosi,#Soko mbuya ityuma kundu, Tubugh’enyota mo mitima yetu.##Omuluhi lwetu lungi, Tuyitsutse iwe Mwami wetu Mwenge,#Wamasika kikutu-kutu, N’obutseme bwetu tuli haghuma.##Yesu bya haghuma netu, Tuh’obuholo, tutseme biro byosi,#Tulamye kw’ebibi byatimba, Kolery’ekyakakala mo kihugho.

title: Kandi Ekinywa Kya Yesu
alias: More About Jesus##C.S. 525-Doh is Ab
content: Kandi ekinywa kya Yesu, Ingye nyanzire eryowa,#Mwaya ho nangakwirira, Mowa amalighe waghe.##ERISUBA MO  :#Akandi olwanzo, Olwanzo lwa Yesu;#Ngandibwira Mulekyetu, y’erighenyera ry’Omwami.##Kandi ekinywa kya Yesu, Ekyo kyalwa elubula,#Ekikaka ng’oluseke, Omo nzira yaghe yosi.##Kandi tupip’Omukama, oyo wasa erilamya,#Oyo wasyaswasa kandi, Eribohol’ekihugho.##Nyanzir’erikala naye, N’erikania naye kundu,#Nyitoke eribakangya, Kwali Mwami gh’obuholo.

title: Yesu Nyikwanzire
alias: My Jesus I Love Thee##CH 276-Doh is F
content: Yesu nyikwanzire kundu, Namayiha;#Mitsye mibi yosi, Ngaghana eyosi.#Niwe Mulamya waghe, Mubuya ngw’ikirirye,#Sinyiritakwanza nga, Lino Nyamuhanga.##Nyikwanzire niwe watsuk’erinyanza;#Wabirinyighul’oko muti Kalwari.#Nyikwanzire, Iwe wanyambalira amahwa,#Sinyiritakwanza nga, Lino Mwami Yesu.##Nyikwanzire erihika okwihola,#Nasyabya ngapipa nyinemuhumula.#N’omughulu w’erihola lyaghe nasyabugha:#Sinyiritakwanza nga, Lino Mwami Yesu.##Nasyahik’ewawe wabirikokotya,#Nasyakupipira yo, Ebiro byosi.#Nasyakupipa nambal’akakira kabuya;#Sinyiritakwanza nga, Lino Nyamuhanga.

title: Nindi Angatulamya
alias: What Can Wahs Away My Sin?##C.S. 93-Doh is G
content: Nindi angatulamya, Nina Yesu Iyo wene,#Niki kyokyangatwerya, Gh’ono musasi wa Yesu.##ERISUBA MO  :#Wamatuwaniya, Yesu Omulamya;#Twabirikiriya, Oko Musasi wa Yesu.##Alihire ebibi, Gh’ono musasi wa Yesu,#Amalusy’olubanza, Gh’ono Musasi wa Yesu.##Wangahika hakuhi, Oko Musasi wa Yesu,#Eyindi nzira siri, Gh’ono Musasi wa Yesu.##Ni nzira y’Omulamya, Itwe twangamukwamire,#Atughulire nagho, Gh’ono Musasi wa Yesu.##Akinda ekihugho, Omusasi wawe Yesu,#Asyatukoly’endata, Omusasi wawe Yesu.

title: Ukaluha Ubwire Yesu
alias: Are You Weary? Tell It To Jesu##C.S. 515-Doh is Bb
content: Ukaluha emwisi w’ebibi, Ubwire Yesu, Ubwire Yesu.#Obulighe bwamakuhika ko? Ubwire Yesu byosi.##ERISUBA MO  :#Ubwire Yesu, ubwire Yesu, Iye ni Mwira kundu;#Siwendisyaban’oghundi nga Ye, Ubwire Yesu byosi.##Mbino ukatebibwa n’abandu, Ubwire Yesu, Ubwire Yesu.#Wamubaha ebinywa by’abandi, Ubwire Yesu Kristo.##Wamasagha eryendereribwa, Ubwire Yesu, Ubwire Yesu.#Yesu akandikuh’obutsema, Umubwire ebyosi.##Wamabya ukubah’oluholo,  Ubwire Yesu, Ubwire Yesu.#Wamamwikirirya n’omutima, Akandisyakulamya.

title: Kundu
alias: A’t So Sweet To Trust##C.S. 588-Doh is Bb
content: Ka lyowene kundu-kundu, Wamikiriya Yesu.#Wamikiriry’emibughe, Niyo Mulamya wetu.##ERISUBA MO  :#Yesu, Yesu namabyanza, Nabirikwanza kundu,#Yesu, Yesu ka ni Mwira, Namakusima lino.##Ka lyowene kundu-kundu, Wamaleka ebibi.#Wamabana esyongebe, N’obutseme kwenene.##Ka lyowene kundu-kundu, Wamaminya Ye Kristo.#Wamaminya kwasikala, Haghuma netu eno.##Nyitsemire n’erikwama, N’erikukukamira.#Yesu mwanza, mwasakana, Ubye naghe Mukama.

title: Natsemire Kiro Ekyo
alias: O Happy Day##C.S. 399-Doh is G
content: Natsemire kiro ekyo, Nikiriray’Omulamya.#Mwanyilusya kw’amalolo, Mwanyerya kw’ebibi byosi.##ERISUBA MO  :#Tutseme, tutseme, Yesu mwatwera kw’ebibi.#Mwatukangya erisaba, N’eritsema biro byosi,#Tutseme, tutseme, Yesu mwatwera kw’ebibi.##Sihali ghundi Mulamya, Nina Yesu Iyo wene.#Ni Mubuya, amatoka, Amalusya olubanza.##Abiririha ebibi, Abirkind’oluholo.#Mwalubuka omw’isinda, Abirikinda Sitani.

title: Abanzirwe N'omwami
alias: Come We That Love The Lord##CH 640-Doh is G
content: Abanzirwa n’Omwami, Ni mwase tuyatule,#Hosi eritsema lyetu, Tusumb’émirenge yetu,#Tutimb’ékitumbi, Tutimb’ékitumbi.##ERISUBA MO  :#Tughend’e Sayuni, Omuyi owene kundu.#Tughend’e Sayuni ko muy’owene wa Nyamuhnga.,##Tuleke abaponi, Bakaghana Omwami.#Nikwa abana b’Omwami, Nikwa abana b’Omwami,#Mubye mukasima, Mubye mukasima.##Tutsemer’e Sayunu, Muyi abuyirire.#Twasyahindana yo bosi, Twasyahindana yo bosi,#Hasyaby’obuholo, Hasyaby’obuholo.##Twimbiry’omo kigugho, Sihabye ukalira,#Twamayahika ewetu, Twamayahika ewetu,#Kihugho kibuya, Kihugho kibuya.

title: Ndamibawe
alias: Redeemed How I Love...#CH 635-Doh is A
content: Naghulw’omusasi w’Embuli, Monalam’omwighenyera,#Lino ndi mwana wawe kundu, Nasyatula gho ehosi.##ERISUBA MO  :#Ndamibawe, n’omusasi wawe Yesu,#Nyeraye, Nyeraye, Ndi mwana wawe kwenene.##Nyipipe Yesu wanyilamya, Nyinemutsema kutsibu,#Niwe kyakakala kibuya, Unzondol’ebiro byosi.##Sinyibiriraw’Omulamya, Nyinemukulengekania,#Sindiluha erimusima, Ngapipa olwanzo luwe.##Nyasi ko nasyamulola ko, Nasyatsemera ewuwe,#Akandinda ndeke ehosi, Mumusibire n’erimba.##Ndi n’amaha kwambikire ho, Kakira omo lubula,#Lero twasyabya naye kundu, N’abamwikirirye bosi.

title: Twasyapolya Ko Aw'engebe
alias: We’ll Tarry By The Living Waters##C.S. 206-Doh is Eb
content: Twasyapolya oko w’engebe, Isoko nyibuya,#Aho Yesu asyatulinda, Hindana lyowene.##ERISUBA MO  :#Twasyapolya oko w’engebe, Twasyapolya oko w’engebe.#Twasyapolya oko w’engebe, Twasyasib’okw’isoko.##Twamaluhibwa n’emibiri, Tuluhuke eyo,#Ko maghetsi asongokwere, Kw’isoko nyibuya.##Tughende k’Omukama Kristo, Atuh’érilama,#Kandi tuminye kw’akalamya, Tunywe enyot’ihwe.

title: Mughulu Yesu Asyahindania Amami
alias: When Jesus Shall Gather Kingdoms##CH 538-Doh is F
content: Mughulu Yesu syahindany’Amami, Bahangan’embere siwe;#Itwe twasyabya tuti omo mbanza, Kiro ky’eriyateghekwa.##ERISUBA MO  :#Asyahunik’engan’omo kighona, Neryo omusung’asyaghuswa.#Itwe twasyabya tuti omo mbanza, Sy’ekiro ky’erilubuka.##Ndindy’asyow’Omulamya abugh’ati: Uli mughombe mubuya,#Kutse asyakwa buba abwirw’ambu: Lwa ho, ghenda sinyikwasi.##Tuteghaye tulindiriry’Omwami, N’esiseke sinemwaka,#Omukwe eghaye itunemuteya, Twe bosi abana buwe.##Tubye tukaghaniry’eby’elubula, Olughendo lwasyahwa ho,#Twasyahangana embere sy’Omwami, Twamatendisub’enyuma.

title: Nzakirwe Mo Kwehi
alias: Is My Name Written There?##CH 617-Doh is Ab
content: Sindikwa engitsi y’efeza n’ezahabu,#Nyanzir’eby’elubula, Nyibye n’ababuya.#Yesu Mulamya mbwira: Ekitabu kiwe,#Kundu ky’Obwami buwe: Nzakirwe mo kwehi?##ERISUBA MO  :#Nzakirwe mo kwehi, Kitabu Kibuya,#Mo Kitabu ky’Obwami: Nzakirwe mo kwehi.##Ebibi byaghe Mwami, Bingi ko museghe,#Asa, Mwami, Nyeraye mo musasi wawe.#Wabirilaghana kw’ebibi byetu byosi,#Byamasos’omunyama, Wasyeryabyo kundu.##Omo Muyi Mubuya, N’enyumba nyibuya,#N’ababuya bane mo, Bambity’obubuya.#N’ebibi sibiri yo, By’eribihya eyo,#Ho hali obuholo, Nzakirwe mo kwehi.

title: Hali Olubanza
alias: The Judgment Has Set##CH 482-Doh is Ab
content: Haly’olubanza binemutondolwa, Twasyayira tuti kwehi?#Twahik’emuliro gh’Omutsweri, Aban’ebyo twakola byosi.##ERISUBA MO  :#Twasyayira tuty’ekirw’ekyo? Twasyayira tuty’ekirw’ekyo?#Twasyabya tunemuteya kwehi? Kutse twasyakindwa n’ebibi?.##Syabiritsuk’omo babirihola, Syasyasa n’omo bali  ho,#Twasyaleberibw’omo Masako, Ayo ni mulangiri wetu.##Twasyabugha tuti eky’omo mbanza, Ebitabu byasanzulwa;#Mundu mundu abwiraw’ebiwe, Atawite omutongolya.

title: Omwami Akabirikira
alias: Called To The Feast##CH 537-Doh is Eb
content: Omwami akabirikira, Atuhindanaye n’abuwe;#Asyatweya ituli tuti: Ahw’asyasira.##ERISUBA MO  :#Mwana wa Tata we Asa, Nikw’Omwamy’asyasa,#Twasyayira tuti kwehi? Omwami asa.##Twasyambalibwa asyombita, Omutongolya asingibwa,#Twasyabya naye n’erikota, Ahw’asyasira.##Ngokw’eripalya asyaswasa, Nikwa asyakangya ebyosi;#Asyakangy’ebyosi twakola, Ahw’asyasira.##Asyatsemer’Abana buwe, Bambal’embita yihenirye;#Twamakinda twasyatsema yo, Ahw’asyasira.##Sitwendisyasighana kandi, Abaghan’erimwowa bosi;#Basyalaka n’erisyalira, Ahw’asyasira.##Mwami tuli n’amaha wawe, Twighisy’erikulindirira;#Sitwesyubaha twalangira, Kiro wasyasa.

title: Biba Omo Ngyakya
alias: Sowing In The Morning##CH 621-Doh is C
content: Biba omo ngyakya, Embuto syowene;#Ubibe mwitungi hik’omwigholo.#Lindirira syere, N”erighesa lyahwa,#Twasyatsema kundu, Tune n’engano.##ERISUBA MO  :#Mulety’engano, Mulety’engano,#Twasyatsema kundu, Tune n’engano#Mulety’engano, Mulety’engano,#Twasyatsema kundu, Tune n’engano.##Bib’eryuba ryasa, Biba n’omo mbeho,#Susagh’ekilumbi n’embeho nyingi.#Erighesa ryahwa, n’emibiri yahwa,#Twasyatsema kundu, Tune n’engano.##Twende tukalira, Tubibiry’Omwami;#Twamabya n’obulighe bw’abahera.#Kiro twasyakiranibwa n’Omukama,#Twasyatsema kundu, Tune n’engano.

title: Omulenge Gh'omulisya
alias: Hark Tis The Shepherd’s Voice##CH 625-Doh is Ab
content: Omulenge gh’Omulisya, Akabirikira Eka;#Kw’esyombuli syaherire, Mo buhyo ni ho syalwire.##ERISUBA MO  :#Ni mwase, ni mwase, Tusisonday’omo musitu,#Ni mwase, ni mwase, Tusisubaye ku Yesu.##Tutabale Omulisya, Tusondaye esyatere,#Tusisubay’omo buhyo, Ho syangabalir’émbeho.##Syamamir’omo  musitu, Syamahika omo ngwangwa;#Omwamy’akababwir’ati: Musond’esyombuli syaghe.

title: Lamya Ab'ebibi
alias: Rescue The Perishing##CH 623-Doh is Bb
content: Lamya ab’ebibi, lamy’abakoni ;#Balusy’obulighe n’oluholo.#Habul’abatere, Sumb’abawire,#Babwire ko Yesu akalamya.##ERISUBA MO  :#Lamya ab’ebibi, lamy’abakoni#Yesu Mughenyeri, Akalamya.##Bamusekererya, Syalibaghana,#Akalinda abatabuke.#Bakune batsire, Ubasabire;#Mo malighe asyababuyira.##Kung’abaherire, Munasesene ;#Balek’engumbu y’ebitowene;#Basule olwanzo, Bakole ndeke,#Basub’oko Muhangiki wabo.##Lamya ab’ebibi, Bikutolere;#Omwami asyakuh’akaghala,#Usondol’abosi Mo nzira nyike,#Minyisy’enduli kwa syalamibwa.

title: Ingye Nyanzire Engulu
alias: I Love To Telle The Story##CH 518-Doh is Ab
content: Ingye nyanzire Engulu, Yo ya Yesu Mukama;#Eritula omwatsi, ghoyo wahol’oko muti.#Ghoyo waly’omwisinda, Ghoyo  kandisyahika,#N’eritutwal’ewuwe, Aherihenia.##ERISUBA MO  :#Ingye nangatula gho, oko bihanda byosi,#Olwanzo lwa Yesu Kristo, Mwami Oyo wetu.##Ingye nyanziry’omubiri, wa Yesu we Kalwari,#Kusangwa mwanyilusya k’olubanza w’erihera.#N’eririha ebibi, mwanyitongolya kundu,#N’ekyo kyokyangatuma: Inamukolera.##Ingye nyanzir’éritula, Omwatsi gho’omusasi ;#N’esyodudy’omo byala, N’eritum’omo lukanga.#Mobyaghaly’Omukama, Oyo Mubuyirire,#Kusangwa atwanzire, Wasingy’oku Yesu.##Ingye nyanzire Kitabu, Eky’Omukama Yesu;#Kikanyibwir’Omwatsi, Y’obuholo bw’egh’Omwami.#Kikanyibwir’Omwatsi, w’engebe y’erikota;#Ilabire emyatsi yosi y’ekihugho.

title: Tulamaye Abaherire
alias: Seeking The Lost##CH 532-Doh is Eb
content: Neryo tulamaye abatere;#Abatere hali ku Yesu.#Tubahindule mo Ngulu Yiwe,#Baminye k’Omwamy’abanzire.##ERISUBA MO  :#Tuye hosi (Tuye hosi) Tweghay’abandu bosi,#Tuletere (Tuletere) Yesu baherire.#Tuby’omo buhyo (Tuby’omo buhyo)#By’Omulamya wetu#Yesu wayiha oko b’ebibi.##Tuletere Yesu abatere,#Abolo bate n’akaghala.#Bakangay’aho basyalamira,#Baminye enzira y’Engebe.##Tughende ngoko Yes(u) atutuma,#Tubye tunemumukolera.#Lamy’abakoni, Sumb’abawire,#Sondol’abatere ku Yesu.

title: Amalima Erire
alias: Far And Near The Field##CH 448-Doh is F
content: Amalima erire ehosi ni ndambi y’erihulula,#Lino ni ndambi y’erihulula Mukokoro n’oko bitwa.##ERISUBA MO  :#Mwami utume abaghesi tulame Mwami w’erikota,#Batume bahindanay’amulo; Omughulu akine ho.##Ubatume omo ngyakya-ngyakya, Utume bo n’omw’itungi,#N’endambi y’eryuba n’erirenga, Bahamule bayaghese.##Mughombe gh’Omwami, Yir’omuhwa hindanay’eby’erigheswa,#Nerw’ekiro wasyabugh’ebyosi, Wasyatsemer’elubula.

title: Tukole
alias: To The Work##CH 576-Doh is F
content: Tukole n’omuhwa, tukolere Yesu,#Tughende tukolere Omwami wetu;#Kinywa kiwe ky’okikatuh’akaghala,#Tuyiry’omuhwa mungi twikiriraye.##ERISUBA MO  :#Tukole, tukole, tukole, tukole,#Tuminye, tusike, tulindirire Omwami,##Tukole n’omuhwa, lamy’abawirire,#Sondol’abaluhire ah’erilama,#N’erikangirirya Engulu Yowene,#Tuyihalambire oko Musalaba.##Tukole n’omuhwa, Tuyabwir’abosi,#Ko amami wa hisi akandisyahwa,#Kandi Omwami asyapipwa n’abosi,#Ababuya basyimbira erilama.##Tukole n’omuhwa, Omwamy’ase luba,#Ekiro ky’erighesa kyamabihika.#Tuy’elubula ew’ababirilama,#Twasyabya n’erimba ko twabirilama.

title: Kol'omubiri Wawe
alias: Work For the Night Is Coming##CH 446-Doh is F
content: Kol’omubiri wawe, Bukinalolire;#Kola hakin’ekimi, Subye mughata.#Kola bukiri mw’itungu, S’uluhe na hake,#Kol’omubiri wawe, Bugh’emibiri.##Kol’omubiri wawe, Kola n’omw’itungi;#Kola ebiro byosi, Sighuluhuke.#Omo ndambi ukiriho, Uyitsingirire,#Ukole bute bwira, Bugh’emibiri.##Kol’omubiri wawe, Lino bulolire;#Bukasonda erira, Tayira luba.#Erihika n’omo kiro, Eryuba ryalenga,#Uyitsing’erikola, Bugh’emibiri.

title: Omo Ngyakya
alias: Lord, In The Morning##CH 39-Doh is F
content: Omo ngyakya nyinemwimba,#Nyikupipe Mwami,#Nguhe erisaba lyaghe,#Mwami ngwikirirye.##Mwami unzondole kundu,#Mo nzira nyibuya,#Unyiminyisay’obwenge,#Miny’ebitolere.##Bakakeng’Erina lyawe,#Ubye ukowa bo,#Ubaswike olukogho,#Balamy’amalighe.

title: Mukeng'erina Ly'omwami
alias: O For Thousand Tongues##CH 155-Doh is A
content: Mwase tupipe Omwamo tuti: Erina lyawe rikengwe,#Mwami ni We w’erihenia lyosi, Erina lyawe rikengwe.##ERISUBA MO  :#Mukeng’Erina,  Mukeng’Erina, Mukeng’Erina,ly’Omwami,#Mukeng’Erina,  Mukeng’Erina, Mukeng’Erina,ly’Omwami.##Yesu Rina, rikabugh’obuba, Mukeng’Erina ly’Omwami,#Mweny’ebibi ngamukwama lino, Mukeng’Erina,ly’Omwami.##Atulamya kaghala k’ebibi, Mukeng’Erina ly’Omwami,#Omusasi wawe atulamya, Mukeng’Erina,ly’Omwami.##Mulenge wuwe mubuya kundu, Mukeng’Erin ly’Omwami,#Abandu bosi babughe bati : Mukeng’Erina ly’Omwami.##Esyondimi syosi syimbe siti:  Mukeng’Erina ly’Omwami,#Yesu Kristo Yowatuholera, Mukeng’Erina,ly’Omwami.

title: Tupipy'omwami Ni Mwenge
alias: Praise God From Whom##CH 683-Doh is G
content: Tupipy’Omwami ni Mwenge,#Tumupipa bandu bosi,#Mumupipe Abalaika.#Isse, Mwana n’Ekirumu. Amina

title: Nyipipire Nyamuhanga
alias: I Sing The Mighty Power##CH 93-Doh is Eb
content: Nyipipire Nyamuhanga wahangik'ebitwa,#Yowasesa esyongetsi, Mwahangik'ekyanya.#Nyipipy'oyo wah'eryuba, Eryaka omwitungi,#Yowahira omukera, N'engununu syosi.##Mbipy'olukogho lw'Omwami, Wasulay'akalyo#Mwahangik'omo kinyw'ekyo, Ebirihw'ebyosi.#Eby'eriswekera byawe, Ngalangira ehosi,#Hano hisi n'elubula, Esyo ndambi syosi.##Sihali kike n'ekike, Kitetukangaya,#Embula n'eryuba biry'okwitegheka lyawe.#Ukah'ebiri h'omuka, Kand'ukatung'ebyosi,#Situsaghe Nyamuhanga, Lero aly'ehosi.

title: Tupipe Omwami
alias: O Worship The King##CH 75-Doh is A
content: Tupipe Omwami w’ekihugho,#Na kandi mwimbe, Tumusime Yesu.#Akatulembera, Akatubika;#Netu twamusaba, N’erih’ewasignya.##Tubwir’abandu, Emyatsi yiwe,#Sitwangaluha, Akaha akaghala.#Iye ni Munene, Akatabala,#Mwah’engebe Yiwe, Erilamy’abandu.##Awity’amaka, Kwilab’abosi,#Lwanzo lwa Yesu, Lwalet’obuholo.#Abirituyira mo bana buwe ;#Ng’abaghala buwe, Twangamukolera.

title: Tata Twas'ah'uli
alias: Father, We Come To Thee##CH 599-Doh is F
content: Tata twas’ah’uli, Tutawity’oghundi,#Niw’ukatulamya, Tutsumule,#Twabya tutesiba, Tuly’omo malighe,#Utuluhukaye, Tata Mwenge.##ERISUBA MO  :#Tata twas’ah’uli, S’utughane,#Wasi erilamya, Towe lino.##Tulusy’ekw’enzighu, Tulamy’obulighe,#Utuhumulay’omo malighe,#Situwity’amaka, Tusul’akaghala,#Utuhe amak’imotwakinda.##Tusule olwanzo, Tuby’abawe kundu,#Tusondol’ewawe, Twase kuwe,#Tubye nawe Mwami, Nomo twangahola,#Sitwibirirawe tubye nawe.

title: Sunyilabe Ko
alias: Pass Me Not##CH 599 Doh is Ab
content: S’unyilabe ko Mulamya, We ngayitsutsa,#Wamalenderer’abandi, Naghe s’unzighe.##ERISUBA MO  :#Uwe Mulamya, We ngayitsutsa,#Wamalenderer’abandi, Naghe s’unzighe.##Mbye hakuhi nawe Mwami, Mban’ighenyera,#Namakukwama ngenyere, Mb’erikirirya.##Sihali ghundi Mulamya, Niwe wowene,#Ndamy’ebihutale byaghe, Unyighenyere.##Ul’Isoko y’obuholo, Mwenye engebe,#Singwity’oghundi Mulamya, Ni nawe Yesu.

title: Ndambi Mbuya Y'erisaba
alias: Sweet Hour Of Prayer##CH 316-Doh is D
content: Ndambi mbuya y’erisaba, Ikanyilusy’omo malighe;#Mbu nyasy’aho Tata ali, Nyimubwire obwera bwaghe.#Mo syo ndambi sy’obulighe, Nasungire akaghala,#Ngind’eryaghalwa ly’enzighu, Mo ndambi mbuya y’erisaba.##Ndambi mbuya y’erisaba, Ukalay’erisaba lyaghe;#Omwami syalihemuka, Akatulinda tutsumulwe.#Namayiha kwiye lino, Nikwa yowambirikira,#Nyine n’amaha w’ewuwe, Nyipip’endambi y’erisaba.##Ndambi mbuya y’erisaba, Ubye ukanyihumulaya;#Nikwa nasyahik’ewetu, Nasyahuluka omo bitu.#Mba bw’isimi n’ababuya, N’eyo ngebe y’erikota,#Aho ni ho nasyalagha, Endambi mbuya y’erisaba.

title: Ebiro Ndatu Byamahwa
alias: Another Six Day’s Work##CH 448-Doh is F
content: Ebiro ndatu byamahwa, Yindi Sabato yatsuka,#Nzemire eriluhuka, Mo kiro kyatsumulaa.##Mwase tupipe Omwami, Yowatuh’eriluhuka,#Omuyisa w’ekirw’ekyo, Alabir’eyindi yosi.##Tutsemiry’omo mitima, Twitsingir’eby’elubula,#Mo buluhukiro bwetu, Ko Mwami Mwenye Sabato.##Eryombomba ry’elubula, Ritusule itwe bosi,#Hosi Kanisa y’Omwami, Ikind’esyongumbu nyibi.

title: Yitsinge, Usabe
alias: Watch for The Time Is Short##C.S. 555-Doh is F
content: Sighuluhe omughul’ono, Teghaya ni muhindo,#Teya sukindwe n’ebya hisi, Mukristo usabe.#Wasy’omubiri ni molo! Kandy’enzighw’ikalire,#Ulindiriry’Omuheruki, Teghaya sighumbaye.##ERISUBA MO  :#Yitsinge Usabe, Yitsinge Usabe,#Uyiteghay’omwitungi n’omo kiro:#Sighumbay’erisaba.##Higha ebikakulenga ko, Lek’emitima mingi,#Wasyaluhukir’elubula, Ho wasyombombera.#Uby’ukasba Mukristo, Omwami akwanzire,#Ibuka kw’akuholera, Bamulusy’omusasi.##Sighumbay’erisaba Yesu, Bya Naye ndambi syosi,#S’umwibirirawe na hake, Lindirir’Omwami.#S’ulind’isyatitimbira, Lek’eritika-tika,#Ni ndambi y’érimulinda, Sighumbay’erisaba.

title: Wibuke Sabato
alias: Don’t Forget The Sabbath##C.S. 653-Doh is C
content: Wibuke Sabato, Omwami atsumula,#Ni kikul’omo bindi, Kilabir’ebyosi.#Tukaluhuk’emibiri, Twabwirw’eby’elubula,#Ni luseke lukaka, Lwalwa ku Nyamuhanga.##ERISUBA MO  :#Utuletery’obuholo, Sabato mbuya kundu,#Utuletery’obuholo Sabato mbuya.##Weraye Sabato, Kandi upip’Omwami,#Wabwir’abaghomby’ati: Ingye Ndi “Engebe”,#Twamayibombeka lino, Tukolery’Omulamya,#Twasyatwaly’okw’isoko, Y’amaghetsi w’engebe.##Tutsemire kundu, Tunemwimbira Yesu,#Mwira Wetu Mubuya, Tumuyiketere.#Mulamya wetu Mubuya, Erighenyera ryawe,#Indi haghuma nenyu, Rikamba Omuyisa.

title: Kiro Ky'eriluhuka
alias: O Day Of Rest And Gladness##CH 463-Doh is F
content: Kiro kyowene ky’eriluhuka, Kyatsumulawa ky’obuholo.#Kikasubaya utakalire, Kyowene omo bindi byosi,#Mwami mo kiro kyawe, Abosi bakupipe,#Tupipe lino kundu, Ni w’erikota n’erikota.##Ni kisokero kitesendaya, Sikiribya mo emighumba,#Kiri ng’éririma eryowene, Esyonyusi sya ho syowene.#Ni maghetsi w’amuhu, Omoghulu w’embeho#Ni ho tukabanira, Ekihugho eky’endaghane.##Ni kiro kikalet’omuyisa, N’erituletera Olwanzo,#Kyokikalek’itwatsir’ebyosi, Erikwama eby’elubula.#Kiro ky’erighenyera, Kiro eki kibuya#Tusond’eriluhuka, N’omo ngonde sy’omo lubula.

title: Erihindana Ly'e Sabato
alias: Sweet Sabbath School##C.S. 608-Doh is Ab
content: Erihindana lye Sabato, Erigh’ekinywa kiwe,#Erihindana ribuka kundu, Likanzemesaya.##ERISUBA MO  :#Hindana lye Sabato, Hindana lye Sabato,#Nyanzire ry’omo mutima waghe,#Hindana lye Sabato.##Omutima waghe atsemire, Erimuminya kundu,#Kikanyisondola omo ngebe, Hindana lye Sabato.##Hindan’eryo Yesu atsumula, Kandi mwanyibuyira,#Omulenge wuwe ogh’olwanzo, Hindana lye Sabato.

title: Ebiro Ndatu Byahwere
alias: Safely Through Another Week##CH 462-Doh is G
content: Biro ndatu byahwere, Twabwirawa n’Omwami;#Tusonde Omuyisa, Mo Kisabiro kyawe.#Ni kiro kilabire, Kyanyibuky’elubula,#Ni kiro kilabire, Kyanyibuky’elubula.##Tukasab’omuyisa, Mo rina ry’Omulamya,#Tubughire ebibi, Utughenyere kundu.#Tuleke ebya hisi, Itwaluhuka nawe,#Tuleke ebya hisi, Uluhukire omw’itwe.##Twamas’erikupipa, Iwas’itwasangana,#Tukweghaye Mulamya, Mo Kisabiro kyawe.#Mwami tuhe muyisa, Bibuya by’elubula,#Mwami tuhe muyisa, Oko byasyaby’elubula.##Engulu yawe mbuya, Ikalamya ababi,#Erighenyera lyawe, Likatulekeraya.#Tuhe erikusima, Twanze Sabato yawe,#Tuhe erikusima, Tubye nawe biro byosi.

title: Twamakukokya Kandi
alias: Welcome, Welcome,##CH 459-Doh is G
content: Twamakukokya kandi, Ebiro by’obutseme,#Mweyo wakabukaya, Kyakakala ky’endata.##Butseme bwawe kundu, Ibwatsemesy’omweyo,#Bahumuly’obulighe, N’eribugh’olughendo.##Kiro kibuyirire, Ky’eripip’omwisaba,#Na atuminyisaye, Muyisa wawe mungi.##Twamakukokya kandi, Kiro ky’eriluhuka,#Wase n’amaka wawe, Omo mutima waghe.

title: Motow'engulu Mbuya
alias: We Have Heard##CH 637-Doh is G
content: Motow’Engulu Mbuya, Ko Yesu alamya,#Tsungania obutseme, Ko Yesu alamya.#Bibwir’abandu bosi, Usoke n’esyonyusi,#Omwamy’ati ya hosi, Ni Yesu alamya.##Tsungania n’oko ngesti, Ko Yesu alamya,#Ubwire ab’ebibi, Ko Yesu alamya.#Tsungania n’ebitsira, Kw’Engulu Yowene nga,#Yasyowibwa ehosi, Ko Yesu alamya.##N’omo malwiro muti : Ni Yesu alamya,#Mwatutongolya itwe, Ni Yesu alamya.#Abalwere mwimbire, Basonde Omulamya,#Mwimbiry’oko masinda, Ko Yesu alamya.##Amahung’abugh’ati: Ni Yesu alamya,#Bandu bosi basime, Ko Yesu alamya.#Sumb’omulenge uti, Mwase bosi mulame,#Tupipe Ow’Amaka, Ko Yesu alamya.

title: Nyikwanzire We Mulamya
alias: I Must Have The Saviour With Me##CH 541-Doh is C
content: Nyikwanzire we Mulamya, Sinangayighendera,#Nyikwanzire mbye hakuhi, Unyihe n’akaghala.##ERISUBA MO  :#Sinangubah’ekindu,Umbwir’ebyo wanzire,#Sihali kyangagha h’uli: Ngukwamirir’ehosi.##Nyikwanzire we Mulamya, Ko ndi molo kutsibu,#Ni Nawe ukanzikaya, Singwite no oghundi.##Nyikwanzire we Mulamya, Aho ndi mo kihugho,#Mo mulumbi n’oko ryuba, N’omo malighe ghosi.##Nyikwanzire we Mulamya, Mbwire eby’ekwenene,#Ungolay’oko Yordani, Umbe n’erisoka yo!

title: Namibuk'omusalaba
alias: When I Survey The Wondrous Cross##CH 120-Doh is Eb
content: Namibuk’omusalaba w’eriswekya,#Omwami w’erihenia mwahola kugho.#Esyondundi syaghe, Sindiswibuka syo kandi#N’ebyongayipipa mo kundu.##Lebay’esyongolu syo mubiri waghe,#Sikandeter’obulighe n’obutseme.#Akandy’obulighe n’obutseme byahindana#Hali akakira k’amahwa.##Nabya nabiritala nyiring’ekyusa,#Neryo nabirilama omo malihge.#Sunzighanaye sinyiyipip’omo kindi,#Nikwa omusalaba wawe.##Naho ebyabumbawa byabya ebyaghe,#Sinangabana ekyo nakulenga ko.#N’olwanzo n’obwenge bwalwa elubula,#Bikaleka inasigh’ebyosi.

title: Itwe Twamaban'omwira
alias: What A Friend We Have In Jesus##CH 320-Doh is F
content: Itwe twamabon’Omwira, Yesu Kristo Mulamya,#Mwaheka ebibi byatu, Amatuh’obutseme.#Twangamusab’akaghala, Asy’amalighe wetu,#Ni Mulamya Mwenge kundu, Yesu Kristo ni Mwira.##Twabya tuli n’omulighe, N’enzir’eyikalire,#Yesu akanditulamya, N’akaghala kanene.#Sitwangaluha na hake, Akandituwatikya,#Tumusabe biro byosi, Yesu Kristo ni Mwira.##Sitani akatutebya, Na tukakwa endwala,#Yesu syangatwibirirwa, Tumusabe kwenene.#Yesu mwakinda Sitani, Netu twangakinda yo,#Tusikay’Omwami wetu, Yesu Kristo ni Mwira.##Mwami mwakola kibuya, Mwatum’Omwana wuwe,#Ritulamya kwe Sitani, Yesu Kristo ni Mwira.#Twasyasoker’ewa Tata, Ahate n’obulighe,#Tumutwalire abandu, bangabya Bana buwe.

title: Yesu Kristo Akabirikira
alias: Jesus Is Calling##CH 569-Doh is C
content: Yesu Kristo akabirikira, Wase lino, wase lino,#Neryo sughend’omo yindi nzira, Wase ukwame Yesu.##ERISUBA MO  :#Wase kwiye, wase kweiye,#Yesu akabirikira uhike kwiye.##Abaluhire basyaluhuka, Wase lino, wase lino,#Ab’emiheke yiritohire, Baban’eriluhuka.##Anemulinda abandu bosi, Base lino, Base lino,#We wahalaya sighuyibise, Wase ulamibawe.##Yesu akalind’abakaghana, Base lino, base lino,#Basyatsema bamamwikirirya, Babuka luba, base!

title: Omo Lukyo L'omweyo
alias: Let Him In##CH 566-Doh is Db
content: Omo lukyo l’omweyo, Mugheni (Anahangene),#Anahangene aho, Mugheni (Anahangene).#Neryo umukokaye, Ukokaye Omwana#Wa Tata ogh’olwanzo, Mugheni (Umukokaye).##Mweyo wawe k’Omwami, Kingula (Mukingilire),#Isyakusigha hali, Kingula (Mukingilire).#Risakana n’Omwira, Asyahumuly’omweyo,#Naye Asyakuteya, Kingula (Mukingilire).##Nery’owa omulenge, gh’Omwami (‘Wa omulenge),#Uyisinge emyatsi, Y’Omwami (Myatsi y’Omwami).#Ukingule oluyi, S’umubwire ‘Iyihi’,#Rina riwe ribuya, Y’Omwami (Rina ly’Omwami).##Kingula omutima, K’Omwami (Mukingilire),#Wasyahabw’obutoki, B’Omwami (Buteya Bwetu),#Asyamba obubuya, Asyalusya ebibi,#Wamakingul’omweyo, K’Omwami (Mukingulire).

title: Ubutawe Akandi
alias: Ye Must Be Born Again##C.S. 26-Doh is Eb
content: Hali yo wasa ku Yesu mo kiro, Amubulya by’enzira y’erilama:#Yesu mwamusubirya kweneny’ati: Kundu ngakubwira.##ERISUBA MO  :#Ubutawe akandi, Ubutawe akandi,#Kwenene, kwenene ngakubwira, Ubutawe kandi (Kundu).##Nenyu mwamakwa ekinywa kiwe, Ngoko Yesu abugha kyo kwenene,#Nabyo byakubera muyisa neryo, Wasyalama kundu.##Abanzir’obuluhukiro bosi, N’erisyimba yo n’abasyalamibwa,#Wasonda engebe ey’erikota, Wikirirye lino.

title: Unyitabe Nyinemukulirira
alias: Come, Great Deliverer, Come##CH 569-Doh is C
content: Unyitabe nyinemukulirira, Wase Mulamya waghe,#Mutima waghe akulindirire, Wase Mulamya waghe.##ERISUBA MO  :#Namabitala haly’oko mwahge, Namabitala ingy’owene,#Unyihekery’ewawe lino Mwami, Wase Mulamya waghe.##Sihali aho nangaluhukira, Wase Mulamya waghe,#Umby’eritsema haghuma n’engebe, Wase Mulamya waghe.##Namaluh’enzira ni nyiri kundu, Wase Mulamya waghe,#Ameso waghe akulindirire, Wase Mulamya waghe.##Mwami namasa, sighunyihemule, Wase Mulamya waghe,#Wowe, Omulamy’ekiriro kyaghe, Wase Mulamya waghe.

title: Angatoka Erilamya
alias: Able To Deliver##C.S. 30-Doh is F
content: Angatok’erilamya, Mo byakakol’ebyosi;#Angatok’erilamya, Abakamowa.#Inyamulusy’omo muliro,#Yesu katok’erilamya abamwanzire.##ERISUBA MO  :#Angatok’erilamya, n’erikulamya lino,#Mulikyetu wamakwama, Asyakulamya.##Angatok’erilamya, Nikwa ni kindu kwehi?#Anawite amaka w’erikulamya.#Mbwire ebyosi mbwire, nikwa Kristo bita,#Angatok’erimbohola n’erinyilamya.##Angatok’erilamya, Mughendi y’uluhire;#Wamakwama Yesu iniasyakulamya.#Sighusaghe Sitani, Uyanzire Yesu,#Leka eritika-tika, Uyiketere.

title: Twasyahimb'endata W'eribwe
alias: Build On The Rock##CH 579-Doh is Ab
content: Twasyahimb’endata w’eribwe, Yesu Ribwe rya kera;#Twasyasika omw’ubahisya, Kanyabungu kabuha.##ERISUBA MO  :#Twasyahimb’edanta (Twasyahimb’endata w’Eribwe Rinene),#Twasyahimb’edanta (Twasyahimb’endata w’Eribwe Rinene),#Twasyahimb’endata w’eribwe, Endata wa Yesu.##Abandi bakahimb’oko museghe, Ow’ekihugho kino,#Abandi mwisi gh’olututu, Lw’eritsem’omo bibi.##Himba naw’endata w’Eribwe, Kibanza kiwe kyowene,#Kyokyasyabamo obuholo, Haghuma n’erilamibwa.

title: Unyibwire Ebya Yesu
alias: Tell Me The Story Of Jesus##CH 534-Doh is Eb
content: Unyibwire ebya Yesu, Ebisihire kundu,#Biwite enzwere nene, Bikanyitsemesaya.#Neryo balaika bangi, mobamwimbira kera,#Kamwaleta obuholo, Oko bandu ab’ekihugo.##ERISUBA MO  :#Unyibwire ebya Yesu, Saka by’oko mutima,#Biwite enzwere nene, Bikanyitsemesaya.##Neryo ngoko bamuboha, Mo mbwarar’iyo wene,#Neryo kamwakinda kundu, Ritebya rya Sitani.#Omubiri owakola, N’ebiro by’obulighe,#Neryo kamo bamwaghalya, Ebyosi niby’eriswekera.##Omwatsi gh’omusalaba, Mobamubamba kugho#Neryo ngoko mobamuta, Kamwakind’eyisinda.#Righenyera liwe ringi, Olwanzo luwe kwingye,#Kamwatek’engebe yiwe, Nyihabawe erilama.

title: Omulisya Mwanze
alias: Lovingly, Tenderly Calling##CH 572-Doh is F
content: Omulisya Mwanze akakubirikira,#Omo kibungo kiwe, Ho haly’obuholo#Kasonda abakali, Balume, Balwana,#Yesu akasond’abo, Ibasa okwiye.##ERISUBA MO  :#Kabugh’omo mweyo gh’olukogho,#Oyo waherire ase kwengye,#Neryo ngakulinda alindire,#Mwami Yesu Muslisya.##Kamwateka eribya ho busana netu,#Asond’abaherire, Base kwiye lino.#Twasyayitsingirir’ewuwe n’obuholo,#Obw’eribirikira, Omulisya wetu.##Situlindirire kandy’enzighu Sitani,#Ni soro eyo moli, Ikasyatuherya.#Yesu yu katusonda, Omulamya wetu,#Twingir’omo kibungo, Ho hali omwanya.

title: Nahirirw'oko Lulengo
alias: Weighed And Wanting##C.S. 49-Doh is F
content: Omutsweri asyaby’asa, Asombola ebyetu;#Tukasyabya ng’ezahabu, Kutse nga mataleyo.##ERISUBA MO  :#Nahirirw’oko lulengo, Lino syoswire,#Nahirirw’omo kinyw’ekyo, Lino syoswire.##Nikwa twasyow’abugh’ati: Kundu namabasima,#Kutsy’olubanza lw’eribohwa, Namey’isyoswire.##Neryo twitaby’omulenge, Endambi yikiri ho,#Tulek’eriyighanyira, Itwayilebya kundu.

title: Baneho Abakabik'emighambo
alias: Blessed Are They That Do##C.S. 55-Doh is A
content: Wamow’ebinywa byo Mulamya, Kabyobikah’engebe ;#Uwe munyabibi, Minya ko hane bakabik’emighambo.##ERISUBA MO  :#Bane ho abasyabike yosi, Bobatsemire,obatsema,#Bane ho abasyabike yosi.Bakatsema, bakatsema.##Eryowa lisa, simuli ki,  Nakakiribawa kundu,#Twamow’itubaha, sitwangalama, Basyatsema basyow’eyosi.##Basyingira omo butseme, Mo muyi wa Nyamuhanga,#Ahate obulighe n’eryaghalwa, Bahik’oko muti w’engebe.

title: Obwira Na Yesu
alias: No, Not One##C.S. 57 Doh is F
content: Sihaly’omwir’oyuli nga Yesu, Sihali, sihali ;#Oyo wangalamya omutima, Sihali, sihali.##ERISUBA MO  :#Yesu asy’amalighe wetu, Biro byosi akasondola,#Sihaly’omwir’oyulinga Yesu: Sihali, Sihali.##Sihali endambi ate netu, Sihali, sihali ;#Mwirimya syangatughaba kwiye, Sihali, sihali.##Sihali oy’ulingene naye, Sihali, sihali ;#Oyo wangatulusya kw’ebibi, Sihali, sihali.##Syangabanik’oghundi Mulamya, Sihali, sihali ;#Iye muta omusasi wuwe, Sihali, sihali.

title: Unyisamalire
alias: Life In A Look##CH 65-Doh is Eb
content: Unyisamaliry’akatubwira, Yesu Yo watuholera ;#Mo musalaba muly’engebe, Aho hanasyaban’ekighona.##ERISUBA MO  :#Samalir’e Kalwari, Samalir’e Kalwari,#Nasyahabw’eribya ho, Nasamalir’omuti (W’e  Kalwari).##Namalengwa k’omw’ibulikira, Enzighu syamanyitegha,#Namalebya oko musalaba, Maka nasyabana gh’oko Mwami.##Nasamalira Omusalaba, Buli ughulu kwenene,#Ndaghane nasyayiketera, Neryo kwenene sinangaluha.

title: Mwase Kwingye
alias: Calling##CH 563-Doh is Ab
content: Yesu kabirikir’omo mbolere, Kasonda uwe naghe;#Mo mweyo wetu kalinda riteya, Akakulinda uwe.##ERISUBA MO  :#Mwase kwingye, Abaluhire mwase,#Yesu kabirikir’omo mbolere : Kasonde wase kwingye.##Akatusabira s’ulindirire, Anemutusabira,#Isiwapon’obwenge n’olukogho, Lukogho luwe kwitwe.##Biro byeribya ho byalaba luba, byalaba kuwe naghe,#Mwirimya asa, luholo lukasa, Lwasa kuwe no kwingye.##Ghanyira busana n’olwanzo luwe, Olwanzo kuwe, kwingye,#Bibi byetu abiritubuyira, Ribuyirwa ni ryetu.

title: Luyi Likingwire
alias: The Gate Ajar For Me##CH 561-Doh is C
content: Omo lukyo olubuya, Luyi lukingukere ;#Yesu abirilingula, Na silwangasyakingwa.##ERISUBA MO  :#Lunakinguker’okwingye,#Lwamalekwa luty’okwingye,#Kwingye, kwingye:#Lutya, Luty’okwingye.##Luyi lunakingukere, Bandu balamibawe,#Oko bera na bateke, Omo bihanda byosi.##Ukwamirire oluyi, Lukinakingukere,#Uyising’omusalaba, Yo ndundi ey’olwanzo.##Musalaba wasyaheka, Biro byosi butseme,#Lwanzo lwa Yesu ni lungi, Tukamukukamira.

title: Mukumu Munene
alias: The Great Physician##CH 530-Doh is Eb
