content: Mukumu Munene oyo, Yesu mweny’erilama ;#Akaleta obutseme, Yesu, Mulamya wetu.##ERISUBA MO  :#Balaika bosi mwimbe, Tupipe Omwami wetu,#Rina riwe ribuya, Ni rya Yesu Mwami.##Mupipe Mwana w’Embuli, Mupipe Omulamya,#Malolo ghosi n’ebibi, Akalusay’aghosi.##Sihali erindi rina, Litoler’eripipwa,#Kutse eritutsemesya, Kasiryangabanika.##Naye akandisyaswasa, N’olukengerwa luwe,#Tukasyatsema na kera, Rikal’ewuwe, Mwami.

title: Wasond'ebindu
alias: Nothing For Jesus##C.S. 100-Doh is D
content: Wasond’ebindu s’uli, N’endambi ku Yesu?#Mo mibiri mibuya, S’uli n’endambi kwiye#Butseme bw’ekihugho, N’emyatsi y’obutseme,#Ebyo ukasondaya, S’uli n’endambi kwiye.##Myats’ikutimbire ko, Kwiye s’uli n’endambi?#Wanyewa n’ekihugho, Kwiye s’uli n’endambi?#Takingula oluyi, Akahumanga lino,#Endamby’akakusonda, Kwiye s’uli n’endambi?##Endambi y’enzwere, Kwiye mute n’omujbiri ?#Mwitsingirire okwiye mute n’ommubiri?#Uwe iwayitsemesya, N’eby’omo kihugho kino,#S’uwite ndambi y’eri-kwamirir’ebya Yesu.##Uli bikoma bisa, S’uli mbuto sya Yesu?#Ebyala biri busa, S’uli mbuto sya Yesu?#S’uwite kyo wasyakangya, Ekiro asyaswasa,#S’uli no obutseme, Walangira Omwami?

title: Namaseghera, Mulamya
alias: I Am Coming To The Cross##CH 224-Doh is Eb
content: Namabirikirwa, N’omulenge wawe ;#Nyeribaw’omo musasi, Wawe ughutika.##ERISUBA MO  :#Namasegher’oko Musalaba,#Nyeribawe kwenene, Mo musasi wawe.##Ingye molo kundu, Mowamb’akaghala,#Wabirinyerya kw’ebibi, Nyikulindirire.##Yesu yo wanyanza, Omo Lwanzo lungi,#Butseme, buholo kundu, Byasyaby’elubula.##Ukaha amaka, Omubiri wawe,#Unyeray’omo musasi, Wawe oghutika.##Nabirilamibwa, Lwanzo n’olukogho,#Kuwe Mwami ngwity’amaka, N’eritunganene.

title: Yesu Mwaliha
alias: Jesus paid It All##C.S. 107-Doh is Eb
content: Yesu asi amaka wawe ni buyira ;#Teghaya Omw’isaba, Uhabaw’omuyisa.##ERISUBA MO  :#Yesu mwaliha, Lubanza lwaghe,#Ebibi byabya bingi, Naye mwery’ebyosi.##Mwami, namalangira, Akaghala kawe,#Weraye emitima, Tuyire mo babuya.##Singwite kindi kindu, Ekyanganyilamya,#Nasyer’omo musasi, Gh’Omulamiya Oyo.##Nasyaghend’omo bitu, Haghuma n’Omwami,#Nambala akakira, Nyikukamire Yesu.

title: Eririba Ly'omusasi
alias: The Cleansing Wave##CH 598-Doh is Eb
content: Eririba ly’omusasi, Wa Yesu  katwerya ;#Kamwaghalibwa, Asonda tubane engebe.##ERISUBA MO  :#Ririba ly’omusasi, Namingira nyeribawe,#Mwami nyeribawe kundu, akeraya, akeraya.##Musasy’akabugha kwingye, Monow’omulenge,#Akabugha, Mweyo waghe, Ineribwa mugho.##Ngahangana inaghenda, Omw’ihenia liwe,#Emyenda yamabyeribwa, Mutima ni Yesu.##Lukogho lw’eriswekera, Lukeray’emwisi,#Ka nyiri na Yesu musa, Oyo y’Omulamya.

title: Sesene, Namikirirya
alias: I Do Beleive##CH 670-Doh is G
content: Tata singwity’Omulamya, Ni nawe wowene ;#Neryo kwingye wamabiswa, Nyikole ki Tata?##ERISUBA MO  :#Sesene namikirirya, Yesu Yo wahola,#Yowut’omusasi wuwe, Nyilwe omo bibi.##Nyikiriry’Omwana wawe, Umb’amaka wawe,#Unyusulaye omuhwa, Oko ndambi eyi.##Ni butseme bungi kwingye, Rilol’oko busu,#Nyiminy’omulenge wuwe, Nyiban’olukogho.

title: Ngandimb'olwanzo Luwe
alias: I Will Sing Of Jesus’ Love##CH 529-Doh is Bb
content: Ngandimba (Ngandimba), Lwanzo luwe,#Lwanzo lwa (Lwanzo lwa) Yesu Mwami,#Busana (Busana) kayowalwa,#Okw’Ise, mwahola.##ERISUBA MO  :#Ngandimba (Ngandimba) Lwanzo luwe,#Ripipa (Ripipa) nasyateka,#Mwahola (Mwahola) ka nyibye ho:#Ngandimb’olwanzo luwe.##Misonia (Misonia) kamwaliha,#Nomo nde (Nomo nde) sindirira,#Risaba (Risaba) siriri ho, Akanyisabira.##Olwanzo (Olwanzo) lungi olo;#Kihugho (Kihugho) sikyasi lo,#Buyira (Buyira) abab’ebibi,#Ebingi ng’ebyaghe.##Sihali (Sihali) ebibuya,#Ebyona (Ebyona) Birikola;#Ngasonda (Ngasonda) tsuka lino,#Nyikangay’olwanzo.

title: Hahuhi Nawe
alias: Nearer Still Nearer##CH 390-Doh is Db
content: Hakuhi nawe, nyiseghere, Hakuhi nawe ho nangikala ;#Mwami nyanzire, Ungwate ko, Undeghaye sinangalwa kuwe,#Undeghaye sinangalwa kuwe.##Hakuhi kundu, sindi naki, Sindi n’esadaka, Mwami Yesu.#Mutima waghy’amabya mubi, Weraye gh’omo musasi wawe.#Weraye gh’omo musasi wawe.##Hakuhi kundu, Uwe naghe, Nasyatsemer’erirek’ebibi,#Matseme ghosi n’eripona, Umber’itsira byo kundu Yesu.#Umber’itsira byo kundu Yesu.##Hakuhi kundu, n’oko nduli, N’omo lubula nasyahangana,#Ebiro ebyosi nyine yo, Nasyalola oko busu bwawe.#Nasyalola oko busu bwawe.

title: Haly'erina Ly'eriswekya
alias: The Holiest Name##C.S. 217-Doh is F
content: Haly’erina ly’eriswekya, Rilabir’awandi ghosi ;#Nery’Omwami watuhangika, Na Mughala anyanzire.##ERISUBA MO  :#Ni rina ribuya, (Erina), Ni rina ribuya,#Ryalwa ku Nyamuhanga ryasa hisi.#Neryo rikimbawa (Erina), n’Abamalaika (Kwenene)#Erin’eryo ni rya Yesu.##Neryo rikamb’omuyisa, Nyanzire eripipa ryo,#Sindyumbay’eripipa ryo, Ngabwira obuli mundu.##Ekyangamba n’erisyimba, N’Abamalaika buwe,#Nasyabya ngapip’erina, Rilabir’awandi ghosi.

title: Yesu Musa
alias: Not I, But Jesus##CH 271-Doh is Eb
content: Yesu musa y’utoler’eripipwa ;#Nikwa ingye sindi kindu kundu.#Sinyitolere ingye riyipipa,#Yesu musa, Yowanganahulwa.##Yesu musa y’ukabugh’obulighe ;#Nikwa ingye unyiwatikaye.#Sinangakolera ebyanganduhya#Nikwa Yesu kay’unatolere.##Yesu musa Yo wanganahalambwa;#Sinyitolere eriyipipa.#Yesu musa, asyanyibanika mo,#Erisyahika eribya  nga Ye.##Yesu musa y’ukabugha obwera ;#Niye musa ngah’ebyagh’ebyosi.#Yesu musa, yukandeter’ebyosi,#Yesu musa, nyiyibere nawe.

title: Ekyakakala Kibuya
alias: Sunlight In The Heart##CH 612-Doh is A
content: Oko kitwa kuli henia, Erihenia ly’eryuba ;#Mo malima n’omo ngetsi, N’eryuba rihenirye.#Erihenia ni rinene, Omo mutima waghe,#Kusangw’aho Yesu ali, Hali ekyakakala.##ERISUBA MO  :#Ekyakakala kibuya, Kiri omo mutima,,#Aho Mwami Yesu ali, Hali ekyakakala.##Ng’esyongimba ngulukulu, Ngalusay’obulighe,#Omwenda ogh’obutseme, Watoler’eryambalwa.#Ngakukwam’omo mutima, N’omo nyumba y’endata,#Eyasitikawa ndeke, Mwisi gh’olwanzo luwe.##Yesu wanyitongolaya, Ndi wawe lino Mwami,#Byosi ni byawe Mulamya, Biro byosi ngupipe.#Ngakukwam’omo mutima, N’omo nyumba y’endata,#Eyasitikawa ndeke, Mwisi gh’olwanzo luwe.

title: Olw'abikirirye
alias: Since I Have Been Redeemed##CH 638-Doh is G
content: Nyine n’olwimbo lubuya, Olw’abikirirye ;#Lo Mulamya Nyamuhanga, Olw’abikirirye.##ERISUBA MO  :#Olw’abikirirye, Olw’abikirirye#Rina riwe ripipwe#Olw’abikirirye,#Ngandisyapip’erina  riwe.##Kristo atolere kundu, Olw’abikirirye ;#Risonde riwe nyanzire, Olw’abikirirye.##Nyinemutula gho kundu, Olw’abikirirye ;#Rikahigh’itikatika, Olw’abikirirye.##Ndi n’obwikalo bubuya, Olw’abikirirye ;#Nyine haghuma na Yesu, Olw’abikirirye.

title: Nyamuhang'asy'esyonyunyu
alias: He Loves Me To##C.S. 252-Doh is F
content: Nyamuhang’asy’esyonyunyu esikatoghonga  ;#Amanzatya esyonyunyu, Naghe anyanzire.##ERISUBA MO  :#Anyanzire, anyanzire, anyanzire kundu,#Nyinasi kwanyanzire, Ingye nyiri muke.##Mubatsi mubuya akasitik’obusoyo,#Amanzatya obusoyo, Atya anyanzire.##Nyamuhanga wahangik’ensyonyunyu, busoyo,#Syangibirirwa abana, Kundu anzire bo.

title: Ndambi Mbuya Y'erisaba
alias: Blessed Hour Of Prayer##CH 324-Doh is Eb
content: Ndambi mbuy’erisaba, Twamabiyikehya ;#Neryo twamasa kwiye Yesu, y’Omwira.#Tuwity’erikirya, Kw’ali Omuteya,#Abaluhire kundu, Akasyaluhukya bo.##ERISUBA MO  :#Ndambi ‘isaba, eyeritsema ho#Abaluhire kundu, Akasyaluhukya bo..##Ndambi mbuy’erisaba, Amas’Omulamya ;#Lyowene iniowa abana buwe.#Katubwira tuhire, Mo maghulu wuwe,#Miheke yetu yosi, Imo twasyatsema yo.##Ndambi mbuy’erisaba, Bangatok’eryasa ;#K’Omwami Yesu Abakalengawa ko.#Mweyo wuwe mubuya, Asyababuyira,#Abaluhire kundu, Akasyaluhukya bo.##Ndambi mbuy’erisaba, Tukandisyahabwa ;#Miyisa y’omutima, Twamikirirya.#Twamikirirya kundu, Sitwendisyubaha,#Abaluhire kundu, Akasyaluhukya bo.

title: Yesu Was'ewetu
alias: Jesus Come And Bless Us##CH 602-Doh is Ab
content: Wabiritugha neryo babiri, Basaty’oko rina ryawe bamasa ;#Wasyatsumula bo, na munabwire, Twamakukwama omo nyumba yawe.##ERISUBA MO  :#Yesu was’ewetu, Ututsumule, Yesu was’ewetu, Ubye hakuhi.##Wabiribya netu, mo bindi biro, Tunemukulinda, nery’utwasire,#Wase Omulamya, tuhy’olukogho, Utowe Yesu na ututsumule.##Wase utabal’emirenge yetu, Mo nyimbo n’omwisaba, bihamule;#Kirirya rikanye, riminyikale, Lwanzo lubye lubuy’enzira mbuya.

title: Ndi Wawe Mwami
alias: I am Thine O Lord##CH 594-Doh is Ab
content: Ndi wawe Mwami ngow’omulenge, Unemubugha naghe,#Kwenene, kundu, ngasonde kuwe, Nyisik’eryas’ey’uli.##ERISUBA MO  :#Mwami nyase (nyase), Nyase hakuhi,#Kundu kuwe k’omuti?#Mwami nyase (nyase), Nyase hakuhi#K’omusasi w’enzwere.##Nyihire lino, nyikukolere, Mo maka gh’olukogho,#Ebyo wanzire naghe nanze byo, Nyisik’erikukwama.##Nyiri n’obutseme buli ndambi, (I)nyinemukania nawe,#Ngo yukakanaya no omwira, Inyinakukamire.

title: Nangakusosa Kundu
alias: More Lile Jesus##C.S. 286-Doh is F
content: Nangakusosa kundu, Yesu Mulamya waghe,#Umb’erikola ndele, Mba lwanzo lw’eriswekera.#Nangakusosa kwenene, Aho ngaya ehosi,#Namayikehya kundu, Mwami nyikukwamirire.##Inyatey’ekihungu, Kamiya kisukali,#Sinangubaha kundu, Nyinasi ko nyine nawe.#Wasyayisy’eriteya, Unyibuyire obubi,#Namayikehya kundu, Mwami nyikukwamirire.##Nangakusosa kundu, Ngukwame biro byosi,#Mbire hakuhi nawe, Ahatehwa obuholo.#Ukambindula mo muhya, Busana n’olwanzo lwawe,#Namayikehya kundu, Mwami nyikukwamirire.

title: Musalaba Wa Yesu
alias: Near The Cross##CH 595-Doh is F
content: Musalaba wa Yesu, Nyikale hakuhi#Eyo hali isoko, Yangalamy’ebibi.##ERISUBA MO  :#Hali musalaba, Musalaba wuwe,#Oyo n’ipipa ryaghe, Omwibya ho ryosi.##Hakuhi musalaba, Monatitimana,#Lwanzo molwandangira, Molwanyibuyira.##Unyibuke Mulamya, Ngulangire eyo,#Nyiban’olwanzo lwawe, n’erikulwa nalo.##Hakuhi, Musalaba, Nyimuyiketere,#Riteya n’eririnda, Nasyikala eyo.

title: Nyirendere Nawe Mwami
alias: Walking With God##CH 195-Doh is Ab
content: Nyirendere nawe Mwami,#Ngo kwalendera Henoki,#Ungwaty’okuboko kwaghe,#Ubughe naghy’omo mbolere,#Nomo ndalangire enzira#Yesu nyirendere nawa.##Sinangatoka tute nawe,#Haly’ebisund’elubula,#Bitegho bighonye by’enzighu,#Syonzighu nyingi sin’omo nzira#Uhumulaye n’engetsi#Yesu nyirendere nawe.##Unyiwaty’oko kuboko,#Amatseme kwengye n’italya,#Mo maka nyinemughenda#Tuhekire omusalaba,#Tway’omo muyi Sayuni#Yesu nyirendere nawe.

title: Olwanzo Lw'eriswekera
alias: Wonderful Love Of Jesus##CH 650-Doh is C
content: Ekyangamba erimba ngapipa Omwami waghe,#Nikwa nindi wangatok’erimba eripipwa rya Yesu.##ERISUBA MO  :#Olwanzo, lw’eriswekera, Olwanzo lwa Yesu,#Olwanzo lw’eriswekera, Olwanzo lwa Yesu.##Ka yona butseme bwaghe, Ka yukanamb’obuholo,#Mo bulighe n’omwaghalwa, Yesu yu kanambumulaya.##Yonaye ngayiketera, Erisyahabwa engebe,#M’omwirimy’inyakolerya, Yesu yukanambumulaya.

title: Nyikwanzire Kwilaba Mwami
alias: I Love Thee Better Lord##C.S. 301-Doh is C
content: Nyikwanzire, Mwami Yesu kwilaba ebyosi,#Kusang’ukanzemesaya, Ni mbolere Mwami.##ERISUBA MO  :#Kinywa kyawe kyangatulwa (Kyatulwa),#Eky’olwanzo lwawe,#Kinywa kyawe kyangatulwa (Kyatulwa),#Musasy’akeraya (Keraya).##Nyikwasi uli hakuhi, kwilab’ekihugho;#Erikwibuka lyowene, Kwilaba erimba.##Kundu unyitsemesaye, Naghe nasyatsema,#Namabya nyite n’olwanzo, Lwawe, ni buyira.##Byasyabya biti Mulamya, Erikala nawe,#Nikw’omo kihugho kino, Tunatsemire kwehi?

title: Ahw'asyanzondola Hosi
alias: I Remember Calvary##C.S. 305-Doh is Eb
content: Ahw’asyanzondola hose, Honasyatsemer’eriya,#Kusangwa ingy’aholera, Mwangwira ate n’ekibi.##ERISUBA MO  :#Yesu kanzondola kundu, Nahik’ewuwe buholo,#Kwali Yo Mwira nyanzire, Syali atambemukira.##Ngatsemer’eribya naye, Ngatsemer’erinzondola ;#Ngatsemera erimowa, Kusangwa ingy’aholera.##Sinditikatika kundu, Ko ndi haghuma na Yesu,#Nyinayiketere kundu, N	asyamulolako Mwami.

title: Ngasond'omwami Yesu
alias: Give Me Jesus##CH 596-Doh is F
content: Kihugho sinyanzir’ekyo, Ngasond’Omwami Yesu,#Kihugho kikanyitebya, Yesu abuyirire.##ERISUBA MO  :#Lukogho ni lw’eriswekya, Lwanzo lute lulengo,#Erilama eryoswire, Tubikirwe engebe.##Kihugho sinyanzir’ekyo, Ngasond’Omwami Yesu,#Mo bulighe bungi Iye, Ni lwimbo olubuya.##Kihugho sinyanzir’ekyo, Ngasond’Omwami Yesu,#Mo lughendo lw’ekihugho, Kayo butseme bwaghe.##Kihugho sinyanzir’ekyo, Ngasond’Omwami Yesu,#Musalaba nyikirirye, Ngasyalola ku Yesu.

title: Twala Engebe Yaghe
alias: Entire Consecration##C.S. 316 - Doh is D
content: Twala engebe yaghe, Bisabo by’obutumbya,#Twala ndambi sy’ekiro, Isyakupipa eyo.##ERISUBA MO  :#Nyeray’omo mumsasi wawe (Nyere kundu),#Unyeraye kw’ebibi byosi (Nyere kundu),#Ebyagh’ebyosi, Nyikutekere byo#Lino n’endambi syosi.##Twala ebyala nabyo, bikole eby’ukanza,#Twala bisando byaghe, Mo busondoli bwawe.##Twal’omulenge waghe, Nyimbire Nyamuhanga,#Twala n’eminywa yaghe, Yusul’ekinywa kyawe.##Twal’ezahabu nibya, N’ebyosi by’ekihugho,#Twala n’amenge waghe, Ukole ko wanzire.##N’erighanirya Mwami, Siryangabya eryaghe,#Twala mweyo ni wawe, Abye bwikalo bwawe.##Twal’erisonda ryaghe, Pipa ry’omweyo waghe,#Twala kundu mutima, Nyibye wawe kwilaba.

title: Nyiwite Omwira
alias: I’ve Found Friend##CH 531 - Doh is A
content: Nyiwite Omwira naye, Oyo wanyanza kera,#Lukoba l’olwanzo luwe, Nabohirwe na kera.#Akakur’omweyo waghe, Alek’eribinduka,#Nyiniker’emwisi wuwe, Ali naghe na kera.##Nyiwite Omwira Iye, Oyo wanyiholera,#Muta omusasi wuwe, oko bandu abose.#Ingye singwite ki kandi, Nomo nangabya nabyo,#Niby’ebyosi inabwekwa, Ngye ndi wuwe na kera.##Nyiwite Omwira naye, Mwahabwa obutoki,#Asyanyiteya iyowene, Asyanyitwal’endata.#Namasamalir’ewuwe, Ngabya n’amaka kundu,#Lino ngakolera ahisi, Nyum’endata na kera.##Nyiwite Omwira naye, Ali n’omweyo mwenge,#Ni Muhani, ni Musondoli, Muteya w’ekwenene.#Nindi yo wanganyighaban’Omwanze ow’embere,#Kwiye ngayikakiraya, Ngye ndi wuwe na kera.

title: Yesu Yo Wambirikira
alias: The Voice of Jesus##CH 226 - Doh is D
content: Yesu Yo wambirikira, Wase mo butseme,#Mutwe waghe aghotsere, Mo kikuba kyaghe.#Monaghenda yali luba, Kundu monaluha,#Yo wamba neryo buholo, N’obutseme kundu.##Yesu Yo wambirikira, Wase kwingye unywe,#Maghesti w’engebe busa, Unywe kandy’ubye ho.#Monaghenda yali luba, Maghetsi monanywa,#Nyiri ho kwiye n’enyota, Kayahwere kundu.##Yesu Yo wambirikira, Kihugho mwirimya,#Wamalebya kyakakala, Kyamakukolerya.#Monaghenda yali luba, Iye ryuba ryaghe,#Mo buli endambi yaghe, Mo lughendo lwaghe.

title: Mbye Wawe Mwami
alias: Wholly Thine##CH 597 - Doh is Ab
content: Mwami bye wawe, namabugha, Ngukwame, ngukwame,#Ngole by’ukanza, Mwami waghe, Ungwatikaye.##ERISUBA MO  :#Mbye wawe (Mwami), Mbye wawe (Mwami),#Eryo risonda lyaghe#Mbye wawe (Mwami), Mbye wawe (Mwami),#Mbye wawe Mwami lino.##Ebya hisi sinzomene byo, Neryo nyibye nawe,#Byosi nyighambawe byo kundu, Ndi wawe nawe.##Nikwa obutsema bwa hisi, Wase tubye nawe,#Ebinywa byo bikanzemesya, Bimbumulaye.

title: Kiro Eki Ky'e Sabato
alias: How Sweet Upon This Sacred Day##CH 458 - Doh is Eb
content: Kiro eki kye Sabato, Kiro ky’eribuka,#Kya Nyaluhanga w’endata, Rirek’ekihugho.##Twangow’ekinywa kibuya, Rilw’oko Muhani,#Rituhana, ribinduka, Tubane engebe.##Nery’omo malwa n’ebibi, Nikwa twamakindwa,#In’asyatuh’akaghala, Oyo wasy’omweyo.

title: Twamabuka Tutsumule
alias: Lord; Dismiss Us##CH 33- Doh is E
content: Twamabuka, tutsumule, Utuhe eritsema,#Tubye n’olwanzo lwawe, Lukogho lw’erikinda,#Nawe utuhumulaye, Tunemughenda ahisi.##Tukakupipa n’ewasingya, Omo kinywa ky’Engulu,#Bighuma biwe rilama, Byabanika okwitwe,#Endambi yosi tuminye, Ekinywa kyawe Yesu.##Biro byetu tulina byo, Tuyiteke ku Yesu,#Tubye n’amaka, mo mweyo, Situluh’omo nzira;#Hotwasyaloler’oko lukengerwa (o)lo Mukama.

title: Mwami Unyisondol'endata
alias: Higher Ground##CH 631 - Doh is Ab
content: Ndim’olughendo lw’endate, Biro byosi ngahetuka,#Ngasab’inyinemughenda, Mwami unyisondolere.##ERISUBA MO  :#Mwami unyisumb’endate, Ngwikiriray’elubula,#Ndata kwilab’ekihugho, Mwami unyisondolere.##Mweyo waghe kasyanzire, Rikala ahaly’obubi,#Abandi banziry’ahisi, Risonda lyaghe n’iruka.##Ngasond’eriruk’endata, Sinyikindawe n’enzighu,#Mw’ikirirya ngandisyowa, Mirenge y’abasyakinda.##Iruk’endata ngasonda, Inalola okw’ihenia,#N’oko nduli nasyasaba, Mwami unyisondolere.

title: Sighughane Omubiri
alias: Ask Not To Be Excused##C.S. 513 - Doh is E
content: S’ughan’erikol’omubiri w’Omwami,#Yiteghekerania, Ughende ukole.#Eyo Nyamuhanga kasond’ikutuma,#Iwasyatsema yo mo mubiri wuwe.##ERISUBA MO  :#Ngasonda, wase sighughane,#Ngasonda, ukoly’omibiri.#S’ughan’erikol’omubiri w’Omwami#Kwenene, kwenene, S’ukahiw’ewuwe.##S’ughan’erikol’omubiri w’Omwami,#Unemukola ki? Ukoly’omubiri.#Righesa lyamera, Abake baghesa,#Kangay’obutseme, Mw’ikoler’Omwami.##S’ughan’erikol’omubiri w’Omwami,#Erighan’olwanzo, Kuwe ni buhanya.#Ndambi y’olukogho, Yesu akasaba,#Ikangay’ebibi, Bihw’omo lubula.

title: Tabal'emwisi Waghe
alias: Thy Life Within Me##CH 279 - Doh is Eb
content: Tabal’emwisi waghe, Uwe Yesu Mwami,#Ubye kwing’isubirya, Okwibulya lyaghe.#Ubye ho mwisi waghe, Uwe Musondoli,#Ubukobe ni bwaghe, Bwawe ry’erihenia.##Ngatek’ekisabiro, Wabiribirya kyo,#Linw’erihenia lyawe, Lyakolery’emwisi.#Kihugho ikyahuna, Omubiri abye;#Omukobe mubuya, Ow’erikusikya.##Bitsuko by’omubiri, Byosi byakulinda,#Byasond’ibyaghenda, Ibiman’erikola.#Hate eriyitonga, kutse eripona,#Kutse eryendererya, Hat’eriyihania.##Nyibye oyuhehere, Sinyiyire luba,#Nyisike inalinda, Ebihano byawe.#Tabal’emwisi waghe, Uwe Yesu Mwami,#Ubye kwingy’isubirya, Mo mabulyo ghosi.

title: Unyirete Hakuhi
alias: Draw Me  Closer To Thee##CH 632 - Doh is A
content: Unyirete hakuhi Tata, Unyibaghalire,#Nyisegheray’oko kikuba, Ngasond’ilihuka.##ERISUBA MO  :#Unyirete hakuhi, (Nyase, unyirete hakuhi),#Mo muliki w’olwanzo, (Muliki w’olwanzo).#Unyirete (mo muliki w’olwanzo, unyirete hakuhi)#Hakuhi nawe (Unyirete hakuhi).##Unyirete Mulamya waghe, isitwaghabana,#Ebyala byawe biri kwingye, Lino  ndangire byo.##Unyirete m’omweyo wawe, Nyisosane nawe,#Unyeraye, nyiluhukaye, Mbye mubuya kundu.

title: Ehosi Na Yesu
alias: Anywhere With Jesus##CH 589 - Doh is D
content: Ehosi na Yesu nyinemutsema,#Eyakandwala Yesu ni butseme.#Amabya ateho, sihatolere,#Amabya ho Yesu Sinangubaha.##ERISUBA MO  :#Ehosi, Ehosi, Sinangubaha,#Ehosi na Yesu naghenda naye.##Amabya ho Yesu sind’ingyowewe,#Nomo nangaghanwa,Nomo ndi muke.#Mwanganyisondol’omo nzira nyibi;#Namabya na Yesu nasyamupipa.##Amabya ho Yesu mo nangaya to,#Natok’eriluhuk’omw’ilubuka.#Nyuma nasyaghend’ewuwe na kera,#Amabya ho Yesu, Butsema kundu.

title: Gender'omo Mwisi
alias: Walk In The Light##C.S. 540 - Doh is D
content: Mwira ulabe omo mwisi, Neryo sutime-time,#Omuka mubuya w’endata, Akusondolere.##ERISUBA MO  :#S na A :#Ghender’omo mwisi, Ghender’omo mwisi,#Ghender’omo mwisi, Mwisi mubuya wa Yesu.##T na B:#Ghender’omo w’eriswekera wa Yesu,#Ghender’omo w’eriswekera wa Yesu,#Ghender’omo w’eriswekera wa Yesu,#Omo w’akaka wa Yesu.##Ghender’omo mwisi mubuya, Omo kinywa ky’Omwami,#Asyakusondola na kera, Asyakolera ho.##Ughender’omo kyakakala, Ubye ukamukwama,#Koleraya omo mwirimya, Hosi hahenaye.##Ghendera omo kyakakala, ‘Miny’olwanzo lwa Yesu,#No kwanza abali ahisi, Neryo mwalamya bo.

title: Nikwa Abaghesi Bali Hayi
alias: Where Are The Reapers?##CH 620 - Doh is G
content: Nikwa abaghesi bali hayi? Baghesere abatunganene,#Bakengete kund’omo mitemi, Neryo ka sibabye abaghata!##ERISUBA MO  :#‘Kwa abaghesi, bali hayi? Babye haghuma netu tuyaghese,#Neryo tutseme tune nabo, Erighesa ryasabya ryahwa.##Musondere omo miyi yosi, Lutswamba lwamaleng’oko ngano,#Musisonde neryo sine mulo, Syosi imwasighesera Yesu.##Lebaya amalim’amabyera, Abosi balindir’erighesa,#Nikwa abaghesi ka ni bake, Omubiri linw’akabasonda.##Inywe bandu mwimay’emitemi, Mughese endambi yikiri ho,#Mubye n’omuhwa Omwamy’akasa, Lebaya amalet’ebihembo.

title: Sinyasy'embita Yaghe
alias: Will There Be Any Stars##CH 626 - Doh is A
content: Lino ngibuka ekihugho kibuya, Kyongasonda erilola ko,#Nasyahangana hakuhi n’Omulamya, Mbita hasyaby’esyongununu.##ERISUBA MO  :#Sinyasy’embita yaghe ng’esyongununu,#Syasyaheny’oko buli ndambi.#Ngandisyabya nabuka omo syongonde,#Hasyabya ngununu ko mbita.##Mo maka w’Omwami nyikole mubiri, Nyiret’emitima y’abandu,#Neryo nyibye n’esyongununu ko mbita, Mwami akatuh’ebihembo.##Nasyabya n’obutseme namulola ko, Naleta emuliro wuwe,#Bandu balamibawa busana n’omubiri waghe n’Omuka wuwe.

title: Yesu Bugh'omo Mweyo
alias: Speak To My Soul##CH 554 - Doh is Eb
content: Yesu bugh’omo mweyo, Bugh’omo mbolere,#Bugha kwingye mo lwanzo, S’undek’ingyowene.#Kingul’omweyo waghe, Imonowa ndeke,#Hira mweyo mw’ipipa, Nyikupupe Mwami.##ERISUBA MO  :#Buli kiro, ubughe, Uty’omo mbolere,#Nyombomber’embolere, Mbolere y’olwanzo.#Biro byosi wakinda, Bwiranda ni bwawe,#Neryo nyowe ebinywa, S’undek’ingyowene.##Bugha n’abana wawe, Kangaya b’enzira,#Busule obutseme, Baminy’erisaba.#Bayitsing’eriteka, Ribya ho ribuya,#Obwami imo bwasa, Twaghey’Omulamya.##Neryo bugh’emigambo, Ngoko wateka yo,#Ibuyirire kundu, Mighambo yowene.#Nyitok’erikupipa, Uwe Mwami waghe,#Risonda ryawe kundu, Nyikole ngupipe.

title: Omw'isonda Ery'engyakya
alias: Just For Today##CH 604 - Doh is G
content: Omwisona ery’engyakya, Sindisaba,#Wayiteya sinyikole bibi lino.#Sinyibughe kinywa kibi, Mutongolya,#N’erighanirya obubi, Lino, nyitya.##Nangakola omubiri, Ng’erisaba,#Nangabere mundu omubuya kundu.#Risonda ryawe nyikole, Rikusikya,#Mubiri aby’obuhere, Lino, nyitya.##Neryo lino namahola, Mw’ikanuka,#Nyiyiketer’endaghane, syawe Mwami.#Omw’isonda ery’engyakya, Sindisaba,#Unyisondole, ‘nyibike, lino, nyitya.

title: Unyibwire, Uwe Muteya
alias: Watchman, Tell Me##CH 180 - Doh is G
content: Unyibwire we Muteya, Bwasesukere kwehi?#Erihenia ry’e Sayuni, Haly’ebiminyikalo?#We mughendi uhangane, Usayire elubula,#Iwambala n’omo mbindi, Ni musakala lino.##Muteya takoleraya, Omo syonzira syawe ,#Biminyikalo byasyasa, Kw’ekiro ni hakuhi.#Ngubi ikandisyabugha, Yasyabuky’abaholire,#Babuyirire b’Omwami, Bahabw’obutahola.##Muteya lebaya ndek’erihenia ry’e Sabato,#Emireng’ikatula gho, Obwami ni hakuhi.#Omughendi namalebya, Ekitwa ky’e Sayuni,#Muyi w’e Yerusalema, N’erihenia rya mugho.##Aho Nyamuhang’ikere, Ni muyi w’ezahabu#Omo kitumbi kibuya, Oyo Yu katabala.#Haly’obuholo ehosi, Amalima akabogha,#N’ekitaka kiboghire, Syonyusi syowene nga.##Muteya tuli hakuhi, N’ekihugho kyowene,#Tughende yo m’obutseme, Kihugho ky’obuholo.#Neryo mowe haly’olwimbo, Olw’ababirilamibwa,#Tughende tuyahindane, N’endeko nene eyo.

title: Nasyabya Aho Ukasonda
alias: I’ll Go Where You Want Me To Go##C.S. 566 - Doh is F
content: Mbino sim’om’obitwa, Aho wasyambirikirira#Mbino isim’omo ngetsi, Kutse ahaly’amalwa.#Neryo wamambirikira lino, N’enzira isinyasi yo,#Mwam’inasubirya nyisikiry’eriya eyu kanyituma.##ERISUBA MO  :#Nasyaya ah’ukasonda, Mwami,#Mo bitwa n’omo syongetsi,#Nyighende, eyu kambirikira#Nyikukwamy’ey’ukaya.##Mbino lino hali ekinywa, kisihire ky’olwanzo,#Neryo kyo Yesu akasonda, Nyitul’omo mbolere.#Wamabya haghuma naghe, Mwami, Nyimusondesonde lino,#Sindirek’eritwal’Engulu Yawe, Aho wasyandwal’ahosi.##Aho twangakol’omubiri N’omwighes’amalima,#Omubii nangamukolera, Yesu Mutongolya.#Neryo namayiketera We, Kusangw’unanyanzire,#Erisonda ryawe nasyakola lyo, Nyibye n’ebyo wanzire.

title: Yihi, Ebinywa Ebibi
alias: Angry Words! Oh Let Them Never##C.S. 581 - Doh is Eb
content: Yihi, ebinywa ebibi, Isibyalw’omo buno,#Omutimq mubuya n’esyondim’isisyatsanda.##ERISUBA MO  :#Nenyu mwanzane (Mwanzane),#Kabugha Yesu (Mwanzane),#Ng’erimbere ngokw’abiritwanza.#Nenyu mwanzane (Mwanzane),#Kabugha Yesu (Mwanzane),#Abana baghe mwanzane.##Lwanzo ni lubuyirire, N’obwira obubuya,#Sibiheribawe busana n’eribugha nabi.##Situbugh’omw’ihitana, Bikalet’obulighe,#Lwanzo lwawe, we Mulamya, Utuhe erikinda.

title: Ni Ndambi Y'erighesa
alias: Harvest Time##CH 627 - Doh is Eb
content: Mundu mwaghend’akalira, Mwahuluky’embuto mbuya,#Nomw’angaluha syangumbya, ‘Niatsumulwa n’Omwami.##ERISUBA MO  :#Neryo kasinemukula, Imwalebya ko singana,#Amalima, ghosy’erire, Ni ndambi y’erighesa.##Ekimi kikalw’endata, Ni kyakakala kibuya,#Kikalek’embuto yera, Mo lukogho l’Omwami.##Bib’embuto sighumbaye, Suhahukay’omutima,#Wamalangira syamera, Ughese omw’itsema.

title: Mukole Luba
alias: Hasten On, Glad Day##C.S. 589 - Doh is Eb
content: Erighesa ry’ahisi ryamahika, Yesu akabirikir’abaghesi,#Lebay’amalima amer’ehosi, Mulete emitemi muyaghese.##ERISUBA MO  :#S:#Mukole, luba, mubik’emighanda#Mukole, luba, Imwasa##A.T.B:#Mukole luba mwase, imwasa,#Muhunik’emighanda, imwasa.#Mukole luba mwase, imwasa,#Imwasa luba.##Ekirw’ekyo sihabye ukalira, Uyiteghaye omo ngyakya syosi,#Emighulu yalabir’erihunga, Mukole luba mbula yite yawa.##Lwanzo luli ng’eyisoko yityuma, Lukalwa elubul’oko Mutoki,#Lo lukatulembera erikola, Ilwatusikya situbye baghata.

title: Nyine Mukusonda
alias: How Much Need Thee##CH 578 - Doh is G
content: Yesu nyinemukusonda, Indi mbumi n’omwera,#Unyiwate oko byala, Kuwe ngaban’amaka.##ERISUBA MO  :#Mukama buli ndambi, Yesu nyinemukusonda,#Mukama buli ndambi, Ndaghaye buli ndambi.##Unyambalaye emyenda, Yaghu y’amenge wawe,#Myenda yaghe itsandire, Nyinemuyitsutsa We.##Uwe wamanyisondola, Inaghenda buholo,#Ghenda naghe biro byosi, W’enzira ey’engebe.##Namahika oko ndambi, Eyaghe y’obulighe,#Kutse ihali butseme, Ndeghaye buli ndambi.

title: Kyangamb'eribya Wawe
alias: Kept For Jesus##C.S. 598 - Doh is D
content: Kyangamb’eribya wawe, Yesu Mwami waghe,#Namaghambw’eby’ahisi, Nyikukwamirire.##ERISUBA MO  :#Kyangamb’eribya wawe,#Namayiteka kundu.#Mbul’omughaso, ndi ki, ndi ki,#Umbe eriminywa.##Kyangamb’eribya wawe, Yesu Mwami waghe,#Ngole ebyo wanzire, Nyibye ngakukenga.##Kyangamb’eribya wawe, Yesu Mwami waghe,#Mbighul’oko by’ahisi, Unyeraye kundu.##Kyangamb’eribya wawe, Yesu Mwami waghe,#Mbye wawe ngoko nyiri, Bindu sibingaghe.

title: Mwami Naghe
alias: My Lord And I##CH 532 - Doh is F
content: Namabiban’Omwira, Ow’enzwere nene,#Ananyanzire kwenene, M’olwanzo olungi.#Nasyabya haghuma naye, Ha eno sinyasi,#Tunikere haghuma, Mwami naghe.##Neryo namaswaghalwa, ‘Waminya ko nyiri,#Neryo nyiyiketere, Yo walaliraya.#‘Rinyisondola mo nzira, Hali kyakakala,#Tukaghenda haghuma, Mwami naghe.##Ngamubwir’amalighe, N’obutseme bwaghe,#N’ebikanyiluhay’eno, N’ebyangatsemesya.#Akambamul’erikola, Ebinyitolere,#Nyanzire iniakania, Mwami naghe.##Anasy’ebyo ngasonda, Eriret’abandu,#Ukamba omubiri, Inyine mutula gho.#Nyiyatul’olwanzo luwe, Okuki mwahola,#Tukahana haghuma, Mwami naghe.

title: Mo Nzir'akanyisondola
alias: All The Way##CH 259 - Doh is Ab
content: Mo nzir’akanyisondola, Yesu waghe Mulamya,#Syendisyakehy’olukogho, Musondoli wa kera.#Ni butsem’erimukwama, Mo kihugho kwenene,#Nomo nangaluha kundu, Yukakol’ebibuya :#Nomo nangaluha kundu, Yukakol’ebibuya.##Mo nzir’akanyisondola, Akakehay’omwagha,#Namalwala inandamya, N’omo nzal’inughuta.#Nomo nangaluha kundu, Maka nomw’angakeha,#Ribwe rin’embere syahge, Rikanyiluhukaya :#Ribwe rin’embere syahge, Rikanyiluhukaya.##Mo nzir’akanyisondola, Omo lwanzo lunene,#Nduli asyanyihumulya, Uwe Tata w’endata.#Nambalibw’obutahola, Nikala n’Omulamya,#Nasyamuha eripipa, kundu y’Omusondoli :#Nasyamuha eripipa, kundu y’Omusondoli.

title: Yesu Akabirikira
alias: Here, Am I, Send Me##CH 447 - Doh is D
content: Yesu akabirikira, Nindi yo nagatuma,#Erighesa ryamahika, Nindi yo wangaghesa.#Ko mubiri akasonda, Akatek’ebihembo,#Nindi yo wangasubirya, Nyine Mwami nyitume.##Wamaby’ute wangaghenda, N’erisoka engetsi,#Neryo hali ab’ebibi, Abatamwasi Yesu.#Wamaby’uli n’esisoni, Ribugha nga Paulo,#Watok’erikangirirya, Olwanzo l’Omulamya.##Wamaby’isiwangatoka, ‘Riteya oko luyi,#Uwatikaye abandu mo nzira ey’engebe.#Mw’isaba n’omo bihembo, Risaba riwatikya,#Ngoko Aruni mwatalwik’amaboko wa Musa.##Bandu baly’omo bulighe, Yesu akabasonda,#S’ubughe omw’ikereta, Singwite omubiri.#Utsemery’omubiry’oyo, Abirikuh’Omwami,#Umusubiraya luba, Uti Mwami nyitume.

title: Mo Bisando Byawe Yesu
alias: At The Fee Of Jesus##CH 618 - Doh is F
content: Mo bisando byawe Yesu, Binywa biwe bibuya,#Ahandu haly’obuholo, Nyibye ho biro byosi.#Mo bisando byawe Yesu, Ngibuk’olwanzo lwawe,#Ni obwenge buwe kwingye, Bukanyitsemesaya.##Mo bisando byawe Yesu, Handu habuya kundu,#Nangalek’ebibi byaghe, Haly’obuluhukiro.#Mo bisando byawe Yesu, Aho ho ngasabira,#Ngasung’amaka okwiye, Butseme n’olukogho.##Unyitsumule Mulamya, Omo bisando byawe,#Unzamalir’omo lwanzo, Ndole ko busu bwawe.#Umbe Mwami rikuminya, Uminyikale kundu,#Namikala n’Omulamya, Yo bulamiro bwaghe.

title: Nyikwanzire
alias: I Love Thee##CH 343 - Doh is Eb
content: Nyikwanzire Mwami, Wasi nyikwanzire,#Nyikwanzire, Yesu, Okwilab’ebyosi.#Nyikwanzire, Yesu, Nawe unasi,#Emibiri yaghe, Iyakangania byo.##Butseme, butseme, kundu butahulwa,#Obutseme bwaghe, Sibwesombolawa.#Naleby’obuteke, Obw’elubula,#Asyangabira bo, omo bwenge buwe.##Yesu, Mwami waghe, Ni w’ukamb’ebyosi,#Eby’erilamibwa, Ne eby’erikota.#Nyikupipe kundu, N’erikwimbira,#Omo bwenge bwawe, ‘Nyanziky’omutima.##Nakusosekania ki Mulamya waghe,#Utula n’obwenge, Ka sulibinduka!#Neryo nyikupipe, Inakukenga,#Omutima waghe, ‘Sule mo butseme.

title: Ribwe Rya Kera
alias: Rock Of Ages##CH 474 - Doh is C
content: Uwe Ribwe ry’engebe, Kuwe nasyasayira,#Kera wabirihola, Busana n’olukogho.#Nyilusaye kw’ebibi, Nyitok’ikind’enzighu.##Emwisi w’emibiri, Sinangaberererya,#Nangakola n’omuhwa, Ebibi sibirihwa.#Niwe wangatulamya, Kw’ebibi byetu byosi.##Muna kihugho kino, Sihali omulamo,#Ikirirya ni rike, N’eriminya siriri.#Ingye mundu w’ebibi, Ungwatikye nyilame.##Nyinemulindirira, Ekiro wasyaswasa,#Nasyayir’endata, N’eriyakulola ko.#N’eribya n’obutseme, Omo mutima waghe.

title: Kibanza Kya Kera
alias: Firm Foundation##CH 255 - Doh is G
content: Kibanza kya kera, Inywe b’Omwami,#Momwahirwa ewenyu mo kinywa kiwe.#Niki kinene akabugh’Omwami,#Rikirirya ryenyu, Neryo rikanye.#Rikrirya ryenyu, Neryo rikanye.##Wabwirwa soka maghestis w’ekiro#Syonyusi syeritebya sisikanye.#Ngandisyabya nawe ‘nakutokesya,#‘Malighe owakasa, syakubahaye.#Malighe owakasa, syakubahaye.##Ukandisyabala omo muliro,#Nasyakuh’amaka inakuhemba.#Suheribawe nikw’ebibi byawe,#Syasyasighalira zahabu syawe.#Syasyasighalira zahabu syawe.##N’omundu oyo wayiketera ngye,#‘Maka w’eriherya syangamubahya.#Na hake enzighu simukole ki!,#Ni ngandisyamuteya omo malighe.#Ni ngandisyamuteya omo malighe.

title: Mukama Mulisya
alias: The Lord Is My Shepherd##CH 405 - Doh is G
content: Mukama Mulisya, Sinyiri nzama,#Kanzondola mo bulisiryo bwaghe.#Akanyipolesy’amaghetsi owene,#Akanyisubulaya namatala.##Namalaba mo musya gh’oluholo,#We Muteya waghe, singangubaha.#Mutso wawe ‘niatok’erinyiteya,#Wamanyihumulya sindibula ki.##N’omo bulighe, ‘wases’obutara,#N’olutehi lwaghe loswire kundu.#Wamabihakaby’omutw’amaghuta,#Naghe nasyaswakubulya ki kwehi?##Neryo olukogho n’obubuya,#Byanganyikwam’ebiro byosi.#Naghe nasyikal’omo nyumba y’Omwami,#Nahiko omo Bwami buwe b’olwanzo.

title: Mwimaye Obwami
alias: Heir Of The Kingdom##CH 185 - Doh is Eb
content: Mwimaye Obwami kuki wayato,#Hakuhi rilama ukayato.#Ubuke, hangana, wambal’engabo,#Yo luba kundu, ndambi yikalaba.##Mwimaye Obwami kuk’iwalinda?#Kuki sulimaya ebihembo?#Neryo ambala Omulamy’akasa,#Ni luba mukokaye akahika.##Ebihanda binene by’ekihugho,#Binemulwa n’erisangulana.#Isighubaha byahika, mwasima,#Ebiminyikalo byasyahika.##Samalira matseme w’ekihugho,#Neryo ayo akalaba luba.#Kundul’ebikoba bikubohire,#Mwimaye Obwami, mwase luba.##Sumb’omutwe, ulebaye embere,#Nyamuhang’asyasa n’erihenia.#Ryuba rikabanika omo bitwa,#Mwimaye Obwami n’obutseme

title: Muhangiki Mwami
alias: My Maker And My king##CH 71 - Doh is D
content: Muhangiki mwami, Bindu byosi byawe,#Mon’omo bwenge bwawe inyinemutsumulwa,#Mon’omo bwenge bwawe inyinemutsumulwa nawe.##Uwe wahangika, ngayiketera We,#Neryo singangayipip’obwenge bwawe bungi,#Neryo singangayipipa obwenge bwawe bungi.##Nasyakuha kyahi? Ebyosi ni byawe,#Olwanz’ukanzondola mutima wa wasingya,#Olwanz’ukanzondola mutima wa wasingya.##Unyih’olukogho, nyibye n’obutoki,#Eribya ho kuwe, Mwami, biro byaghe ni We,#Eribya ho kuwe, Mwami, ebiro byaghe ni We.

title: Kwe! Muteya
alias: What of The Night?##CH 184 - Doh is D
content: Kwe! Muteya k’oluhimbo, L’omuyi we Sayuni,#Emyatsi yiwe y’ekiro? Engyakya ni hakuhi,#Haly’ebiminyikalo eby’erikya?#Haly’ebiminyikalo eby’erikya?##Nery’omo lughendo lwetu, Twalebya eyisirya,#Twaghotsera omo ngetsi, Kisokero sihali,#Kundu, kundu, Twasyalol’oko Bwami,#Kundu, kundu, Twasyalol’oko Bwami.##Twasyaleby’ekyakakala, Engununu y’engyakya,#Mbuya yihenirye kundu, Yakolery’elubula,#Mutsemer’ilama liri hakuhi,#Mutsemer’ilama liri hakuhi.##Twasamalir’ekitsutsu, Eyisirya sihali,#Tuy’ember’eyo yoluba, Twasyaleby’eyisirya,#Mutseme mwimbe esyonyimbo syenyu,#Mutseme mwimbe esyonyimbo syenyu.

title: Mubuke Abaghombe
alias: How Long?##CH 354 - Doh is D
content: Mubuke abaghombe, Abandu b’Omwami,#Muwaty’omo maboko, Engabo sya Yesu,#Mo nzira y’erikinda, Twasondolwa na Yesu,#Tubye n’omuhwa mungi, Imo twasyakinda.##Engubi syamabugha, Mwase imwe bosi,#Embita y’obuyingo, Ni bihembo byenyu.#Enzighu syamakala, Muhangane n’erilwa,#Mubye n’omuhwa mungi, Mukinde Sitani.##Mubuke na muyalwe, Simutike-tike,#Sihabye ukasiba, Tungerera Yesu,#Muhek’ebyuma byenyu, By’amalwa : Rikirirya,#Muhabwe erikinda, N’obutseme bungi.##Mubuke kuba luba, Muyakwe kutsibu,#Mwikiriray’erina, Riwe mwasyakinda,#Neryo ebyuma byosi, Mubih’Omwami Yesu,#Mwasyaban’obuholo, Ob’omo lubula.

title: Ngasonda Erikirirya
alias: O For A Faith##CH 245 - Doh is Bb
content: Ngasonda erikirirya, Rikirirya kundu,#Rite mo ititimana, kindu kyosi,#Ndambi y’eryaghalwa,#Ndambi y’eryaghalwa.##Erite yitong’omwisusumana bulighe,#Neryo mo mighulu yo mwagha,#Inikirirya Nyamuhanga,#Nikirirya Nyamuhanga.##Rikirirya ryakolerya, Neryo n’omo malwa,#Siryeryubaha omwirimya,#Kutse bulighe obw’enzala,#Enzala n’eryaghalwa.##Syalyubaha ekihugho, Eriponwa mukyo,#Syangatoghibwa mw’itebya, n’amabehi,#Bibi n’eryubahya, Ebibi n’eryubahya.##Mwamy’umbe erikirirya, Nery’imo natoka,#Erigherya muna kihugho kino,#Erimya obutseme, Erimya obutseme.

title: Obutseme Buli Oko Basyaya Yo
alias: How Cheering!##CH 387 - Doh is E
content: Obutseme buli oko basyaya yo,#Akine ho mwirimya wa hisi,#Byamusikya, inakinda ritebya ry’enzighu,#Byamusikya, inakinda ritebya ry’enzighu.##Ebyo byatwibukya by’obuluhukiro,#Aho batunganene basyabya;#Ibayibera n’Omwira obutaghabana,#Ibayibera n’Omwira obutaghabana.##Ni kihugho kite banika mo bibi,#N’eritebya kasiryehika yo.#Ho hali obutseme butesyahwa na kera,#Ho hali obutseme butesyahwa na kera.##Sihali oyo wasyabya akalira,#Luholo silwesyahika yo,#Esyondulani syaho basyabya ho na kera,#Esyondulani syaho basyabya ho na kera.##Kyangatuha ndambi yangahika luba,#Twalangir’Omulamya akasa,#Akatutwala omo kihugho ekibuya,#Akatutwala omo kihugho ekibuya.

title: Mulamya Ka Yo Mulisya
alias: Saviour, Like A Shepherd##CH 394 - Doh is Eb
content: Mulamya ka yo Muslisya, Utusondele lino,#Ututwale bulisiryo, Himba ndek’ekitunga.#Mwami Yesu iyowene, Yukasondola ghuwe,#Mwami Yesu iyowene, Yukasondola ghuwe.##Twe bana bawe ubye Omwira, uwe Muteya wetu,#Buhyo bwawe teghaya bo, Situkole ebibi.#Mwami Yesu towe lino, Twamasab’ibuyira,#Mwami Yesu towe lino, Twamasab’ibuyira.##Wabiritulagha nikwa wasyaligha abandu,#Wasyaghenyera bo, Eriha b’olukogho.#Mwami Yesu tukwanzire, Ribya bawe kwenene,#Mwami Yesu tukwanzire, Ribya bawe kwenene.

title: Rikirirya Riri
alias: Blessed Hope##CH 379 - Doh is F
content: Rikirirya riri, Ery’enzwer’enene,#Kwilab’eritsema lyosi lya muna kihugho.##Syongununu mbuya sikakoleraya,#Kw’itwe mughulu w’erihola w’erilubuka.##Twamaghalwa mo mweyo buba, bulighe,#Mulenge akatubwira: Mwami abanzire.##Erilw’e Kalwari, mulengy’akabugha,#Ngununu iyakolery’erikirirya ryetu.

title: Sihali Mwirimya
alias: No Night There##CH 558 - Doh is Eb
content: Mo Kihugho kibuya, Kiri m’omuyisa,#Asyabya ho nakera, Sihali mwirimya.##ERISUBA MO :#Sihali erira, sihali n’oluholo,#Biro sibyendisyibukwa, Sihali mwirimya.##N’esyonyusi ni lulu, Mo muyi mubuya,#N’enzira ni zahabu, Sihali mwirimya.##N’omo muyi mubuya, Sihaly’erikinga,#N’olusi olw’engebe, Lunemusenda ho.##Sihali sond’eryuba, Yesu yona ryuba,#Yu kakoleray’ehosi, Sihali mwirimya.

title: Mwami Byasyabya Kiro Ki
alias: Christ Returneth##CH 536 - Doh is D
content: Eh mbino ni ndambi y’erisesukala,#Maseghe w’eryub’iniahigh’omwirimya.#Neryo akasyasa Yesu omw’ihenia,#Akandisyakoky’abuwe.##ERISUBA MO :#Byasyabya kiro ki Mwami,#Mughulu twasyimba:#Anemwasa, Mwami Yesu,#Aleluya, Amen, Aleluya, Amen.##Eh mbin’omw’itungi, eh mbin’omw’igholo,#Eh bin’omo kati kanene, mwirimya,#Asyahwa ho omw’ihenia, ery’asyasa;#Akandisyakoky’abuwe.##Butseme twamahabwa obuta hola,#Buta syasunga oko ndwala, misonia.#Erisyatwalw’omo bitu omw’ihenia;#Akandisyasy’oko buwe.

title: Omukwi Amasa
alias: Behold, The Bridgegroom##C.S. 868 - Doh is A
content: Wasyabya unemuteya Yesu, Asyasya,#Wasyabya unemuteya Yesu, Asyasya,#Lebay’akasa, Lebay’akasa,#Uteghaye lebay’anemwasa##ERISUBA MO :#Masa, Omukwi amasa,amasa,#Masa, Omukwi amasa, amasa,#Masa, amasa, masa, Amasa,#Uteghaye mas’Omwukwi masa.##Mukokotay’esisek’amasa, amasa,#Mukokotay’esisek’amasa, amasa,#Amasa, amasa, masa, amasa,#Uteghaye mas’Omwukwi masa.##Mwase tuhindane nay’amasa, amasa,#Mwase tuhindane nay’amasa, amasa,#Amasa kundu, amasa kundu,#Uteghaye mas’Omwukwi masa.##Tumwimbire Aleluy’amasa, amasa,#Tumwimbire Aleluy’amasa, amasa,#Amasa kundu, amasa kundu,#Tumwimbire Aleluy’amasa.

title: Sitwasy'ekiro
alias: We Kow Not The Hour##CH 540 - Doh is C
content: Sitwasy’ekiro, Yesu akandisyasa,#Nikw’omughulu ali hakuhi kundu.#Biminyikalo byabirihik’ebyosi#N’ekiro tutasi.##ERISUBA MO :#Asyasa, tulinde tuteghaye,#Asyasa, Aleluya, Aleluya,#Asyasy’oko bitu, N’erihenia ery’Ise#N’ekiro tutasi.##Atunganania, Ekitabu ky’obwami,#Bakaminyira omo eby’ekwenene#Eryasa riwe, omo Baminyereri,#N’ekiro tutatsi.##Luseke lwetu, siluhumber’eryaka;#Tukole lino, tulindiriry’Omwami.#Tumupipire situbye ne eryumbya,#N’ekiro tutasi.

title: Twamulinda
alias: Wainting And Watching##CH 542 - Doh is Eb
content: Sinyasi endambi asyasa, Mwitungu kutsy’omw’igholo,#Mbino ndambi ey’erigholo, Mbinw’eryuba ryahuluka.#Akatubwira tuteghaye, Twakay’esiseke syetu,#Neryo amasa atwegheye, Tubye itukamulinda.##ERISUBA MO :#Twamulinda ne (Riteya, tukakulinda uwe),#Twamulinda ne (Riteya, tukakulinda),#Twamulinda ne (Riteya, tukakulinda uwe),#Twateya itwamulinda.##Namibuk’olukogho luwe, Nzwere y’erilama lyetu,#Mwasigha n’enyumba nyibuya, Asy’aholere ababi.#Nyasi ko byasyamutsemesya, Neryo ng’itwe bandu buwe,#Twamakangany’olwanzo lwetu, Tuby’itunamulindire.##Yesu Mulamya Ekitagha, We wasi ko ngateghaya ;#Erikulola ko lyowene, N’erisyakokibwa nawe.#Wasa oko bandi abandu, Neryo ng’Omutsweri wabo,#Kwingye wasyabya Omwir’oyo, Nateya n’erikulinda.

title: Twalangir'amasalali
alias: Gleams Of The Golden Morning##CH 547 - Doh is G
content: Twamabihik’oko mughulu w’eryasa rya Yesu,#Akasyahek’abandu buw’omo nyumba y’endata.##ERISUBA MO :#Twalangir’amasalali w’eryuba#Akahigh’omwirimya;#Twalangir’amasalali w’eryuba#N’erilubuka.##Haghuma n’abalaika buwe, Mwami asyasa,#Akandisyatwal’Ababuyirire, Butahola.##Engulu inemutulw’ehosi, Oko bihanda;#Omwami w’obuheruky’amasa, n’Engubi yiwe.##Abanze abaghabana kera, Basyahindana;#Misonia yabo ab’obulighe, Yasyasangulwa.

title: Mwatsi Mubuya
alias: Hold Fast Till I Come##CH 548 - Doh is G
content: Mwatsi mubuya, Oko babuya,#Lebaya ngandisya luba kundu;#Ubye embangi, omo butseme,#Wasyahabwa akakira katehwa.##ERISUBA MO :#Uteghay’erikirirya ryawe,#Ekihugho kihya ikyasasya,#Wase wingire omo butseme,#Wasyahabwa akakira katehwa.##Twasyateya itunemusaba,#Akasyasa ng’omurahy’oko bandi;#Tunasi Ye ngo kwali hakuhi,#Nikwa sitwasy’ekiro nga ni kyahi.##Tukayiketer’Ekinywa kiwe,#Neryo kyo kikabugh’eryasa riwe;#Rikirirya ryetu y’endaghane,#Ko ngasyasa luba: Ubye Embangi.

title: Butseme Oko Kihugho
alias: Joy To The World##CH 189 - Doh is D
content: Butseme oko kihugho, Yesu akasyasa,#Buli mweyo mwangirire, byabumbawa byosi bimbe.#Byabumbawa bimbe, Byabumbawa bimbe,#Byosi bimbe, Byabumbawa byosi bimbe.##N’Omwami asyatabala, Bandu neryo bimbe,#Miti n’ebitwa n’amabwe, Mwimbire butseme bungi.#Mwimbire butseme, Mwimbire butseme,#Mwimbire Omwami n’obutseme bungi.##Akasyatabala ndeke, Akasyatuhana,#Bandu bubuya buwe, Lwanzo lw’eriswekera kundu.#Olwanzo lw’eriswekya, Olwanzo lw’eriswekya,#Olwanzo lw’eriswekya, lwanzo luwe.

title: Ribya Yo Byasyatuha Ki
alias: To Be There##CH 199 - Doh is G
content: Nikwa ko tukanabugha, Eby’ekihugho kibuya,#Tukole bibuya byaho; Ribya yo ryasatuha ki?#Tukahul’enzira ya ho, Sihakabir’ezahabu,#Neryo twamuzunzikania, twahika yo twasyabya ho.##Twabugha ko hasosire, Hat’ebibi n’oluholo,#Kutse ritebya siriri, Twahika yo twasyabya ho.#Tukabugha n’eby’olwanzo, N’esyokanzu syasyambalwa,#Tukatsemera byo kundu, Ribya yo ryasatuha ki?##Nyitimbirwe ko n’ebibi, Ndungananay’eriya yo ;#Neryo naghe nyiyowe mo, erisyabya yo kwenene.#Neryo twasyalendera omo kihugho ky’obutseme,#Haghuma n’Abalaika, na Yesu Mulamya wetu.

title: Twasubwire Erikulakira
alias: Lord, We Have Met##CH 26 - Doh is F
content: Tata Mwenge twasubwire, erkulakira,#Twamayikehya kundu, twayolobeka;#Twitsutse eribuyirwa.##Twamasa erikusima, Kowa watuteya kundu,#Ubye ukatwibuka watutsumula;#Iwasubuly’ah’uli.##Ayi, twabere bahanya, Tuly’ab’erighanwa kundu,#Neryo tukakita oko nzira yawe ;#Neryo lino twamaswasa.##Mwami w’emiyisa yosi, Ni nawe ukahitaya,#Lebaya mo lukogho, Twamakughonga;#Tusule n’Ekinywa kyawe.

title: Kandi Mulamya
alias: Our Parting Hymn##CH 34 - Doh is Ab
content: Kandi Mulamya tukakupipa,#Erina ryawe ka ni ribuya!#Tukalind’Ekinywa ky’obuholo,#N’omughulu tukasuba eka.##Tuhy’obuholo m’onzira yetu,#Utuby’embere n’enyuma wetu!#Uteghay’eminywa oko bibi,#Itwakupipa n’erikukenga.##Tuhy’obuholo mo kiro eki!#Kyakakala kihigh’omwirimya!#Utulinde tubye bawe Yesu,#N’ekiro kibye ngomo ritungi.##Tuhy’obuholo omo kihugho,#Tuwatikaye omo bulighe.#Neryo twitab’omulenge wawe,#Tuhy’obuholo obw’erikota.

title: Nikwa Nabya N'ebibi
alias: Chief of Sinners##CH 238 - Doh is Ab
content: Nikwa nabya n’ebibi, Yesu mwanyitongolya,#Mwanyutir’omusasi, Mwangul’omo luholo,#Nasyabya naye kera, Ng’omutahi n’momuti.##Ighenyera rya Yesu, Ryusulaya ekyanya,#Siryangalengwa ko ki, Ryasyabya ho na kera;#Niwe wanyibwira ryo, Ngye sinabya nyasi ryo.##Nikwa nabya n’ebibi, Yesu ‘labire byosi,#Anasy’obwera bwaghe, Andamy’omo malighe;#Ndi omukobe wuwe, Sindyedi syaghalirwa.

title: Situli N'omuyi Omo Kihugho
alias: No Abiding City Here##CH 308 - Doh is G
content: Situli n’omuy’omo kihugho,#Tuli mukyo tuli abaghendi.#Nikw’ekyo tukatsemera,#Neryo tukasond’omuyi,#Alabire obubuya.##Situli n’omuy’omo kihugho,#Tukaya ewetu elubula.#Ye Sayuni itula ho,#Muli kyakakala kundu,#Kikakoleraya ndeke.##Neryo tukadisyatsemera yo,#Ahw’abaghendi basyaluhuka.#Kyangamb’ebipupa lino,#Ngaghuluka ngasyaya yo,#Ngayibera nawe Mwami.##Mutima waghe lek’erighanya,#Lebay’endambi Mwami ambere.#Nyo nyibuya, yo nyibuya,#Naghe inayiketera,#Rihik’okw’ibirikirwa.

title: Erina Rya Yesu
alias: Precious Name of Jesus##CH 523 - Doh is Ab
content: Yesu ni Mwami w’abami, Oyo abiritwanza,#Twamaby’itwamikirirya, Tukandilama lino.##ERISUBA MO :#Erina rya Yesu, Erina ly’Omulamya,#Tumwanzi, biro byosi,#Ni Mwami Mwenge wetu.##Tuyire erina riwe, Mw’inene biro byosi,#Ni erina ly’erilamya, Kumbe wamikirirya.##Usaby’oko rina riwe, Wamabya n’obulighe;#Akandikuh’obutseme, N’akaghala kanene.

title: Yesu Mulamya W'ekwenene
alias: Blessed Assurance##CH 608 - Doh is D
content: Yesu Mulamya w’ekwenene,#Akamb’obutseme n’obuholo,#Nyihabaw’erilama riwe,#Nyeribw’omo musasi wuwe.##ERISUBA MO :#Omwatsi oyo lwimbo lwaghe,#Biro byosi nasyamupipa.#Omwatsi oyo lwimbo lwaghe,#Biro byosi nasyamupipa.##Namayiteka inatsema#N’omw’ikirirya ngasung’Omwami.#Akandetera Malaika,#Bakanyiteya andamaye.##Sindi n’ekindu akandwala,#Mwisi wa Yesu inatsumulwa;#Ngalindirira omw’isika,#Bwenge buwe bunyitolere.

title: Mo Musalaba Gh'omulamya
alias: Glory To His Name##C.S. 300 - Doh is Ab
content: Mo musalaba gh’Omulamya,#Aho honasab’erilama,#Mutima waghe kamweribwa,#Na apipawe.##ERISUBA MO :#Na apipawe, Na apipawe.#Kwamwanyilamy’omo musasi#Na apipawe.##Ko Musalaba w’eryaghalwa,#Yesu ane omo mutima.#Kamwanyilamy’omo musasi,#Na apipawe.##Nyitsemire namabilama,#Mwisi wa Yesu inatsumulwa;#N’oko muti mwanyiholera,#Na apipawe.##Yesu kalamya mo musasi,#Anyilusaya omo bibi,#N’erinyitwala omw’ilama#N’oko muti mwanyiholera,#Na apipawe.

title: Eribya Wa Yesu
alias: His Way With Thee##C.S. 58 - Doh is G
content: Eribya wa Yesu kwehi ni sonda ryawe,#Wangaghenda naye mo nzira enge,#Ukasonda iwahek’omuheke wawe?#Abye Omusondoli.##ERISUBA MO :#Butoki buwe bukutolere.#Musasi wuwe iniasyakwera,#Ikw’ebyo iwaligha byowene#Akol’erisonda liwe nawe.##Ukasond’iwitaba wabirikirwa ko?#Waban’obuholo wamuh’ebyosi?#Wasond’obutoko isibakeha lino?#Abye Omusondoli.##Ukasond’obutseme omo Bwami buwe?#Wangakinda omw’irengwa ko ryosi?#Wangakola omubiri wuwe gho ndeke?#Abye Omusondoli.

title: Hamabya Olwanzo
alias: Love At Home##C.S. 580 - Doh is Ab
content: Bindu byosi byowene, Hamaby’olwanzo,#N’omulenge mubuya, Hamaby’olwanzo.#Hali buholo aho, N’obutsem’omo nyumba,#N’eribya ho ribuya,  Hamaby’olwanzo.##ERISUBA MO :#Hamabya Olwanzo,#Biro byosi buholo;#Hamaby’olwanzo.##Butseme omo nyumba, Hamaby’olwanzo,#Sihali eritsuro, Hamaby’olwanzo.#Akalyo kakasiha, N’amalim’iniuwana,#N’eribya ho ribuya,  Hamaby’olwanzo.##N’omo lubul’endata, Hali butseme,#Bamalangir’olwanzi, Mo nyumba yetu.#Meso akatsema n’ebihangikwa by’Omwami, Nyamuhang’inalenya, Hamaby’olwanzo.##Uwe Yesu mbye wawe, Wawe kwenene,#Neryo imo hasyabya, Lwanzo mo nyumba.#Nasikala buholo, Indasyakol’ebibi,#Nasyatsumulwa kundu, Hamaby’olwanzo.

title: Tuhe Omuliro W'eribya Ho
alias: O For That Flame##CH 210 - Doh is Bb
content: Tuhe omuliro wawe, W’eribya ho waka kera,#Mowasondola endate, Ababuyirira bawe.##Habo mwey’ow’abikere, Mo mweyo wa Ibrahimu,#Kandi Mulikyetu Paulo, Atokesibwa Muliro.##Lukogho lwawe siluli, N’amaka ebiro bino?#Ng’omughulu owa Musa, Ayubu n’owa Eliya?##Mughulu wa kera Mwami, Wibuke n’omw’ighenyera,#Bukay’emitima yetu, Mo Muka Abuyirire.

title: Muli Kaghala Omo Musasi
alias: There Is Power In The Blood##C.S. 27 - Doh is Bb
content: Nikw’ukasond’erikind’ebibi, Kiriry’omusasi wa Yesu,#Nikw’ukasond’eky’erikinda mo, Gh’omusasi gh’Omulamya.##ERISUBA MO :#S-A :#Muli kaghal’omo musasi,#We Kyana ky’Embuli,#Muli kaghal’omo musasi,#Gh’Omwana wa Nyamuhanga.##T-B:#Kundu muli kaghala mo musasi,#We Kyana ky’Embuli,#Kundu muli kaghala mo musasi,#Gh’Omwana##Ukasonda neryo iweribwa, Kiriry’omusasi wa Yesu,#Wase mweghay’oko musalaba, Akweray’omo musasi.##Neryo ukasonda iwahenia, Kiriry’omusasi wa Yesu,#Angakwery’ebitingu by’ebibi, Gh’omusasi gh’Omulamya.##Ukasond’erikolera Yesu, Kiriry’omusasy’akalamya,#Ukasonda waby’ukamupipa, Kiriry’omusasi Wuwe.

title: Kiro Yesu Asyasa
alias: There’ll Be No Dark valley##C.S. 854 - Doh is F
content: Butseme, ritsema, twasyahabwa,#Butseme, ritsema, twasyahabwa,#Butseme, ritsema, twasyahabwa,#Kiro Yesu asyasa.##ERISUBA MO :#Kiro Yesu asyasa (Asa),#Kiro Yesu asyasa (Asa) ,#Butseme, ritsema, twasyahabwa,#Kiro Yesu asyasa.##Twasyimb’esyonyimbo sy’obutseme,#Twasyimb’esyonyimbo sy’obutseme,#Twasyimb’esyonyimbo sy’obutseme,#Kiro Yesu asyasa.##Sihali misonia asyabyasa,#Sihali misonia asyabyasa,#Sihali misonia asyabyasa,#Kiro Yesu asyasa.##N’eryaghalwa ryosi ryasahwa ho,#N’eryaghalwa ryosi ryasahwa ho,#N’eryaghalwa ryosi ryasahwa ho,#Kiro Yesu asyasa.

title: Yesu Y'omwira Ulabire
alias: The Best Friend Is Jesus##CH 528 - Doh is G
content: Yesu y’Omwira ulabire, Amalighe akwaghalya,#Yukaseng’ebironda, by’omo mutima wawe,#Yesu y’Omwira ulabire.##ERISUBA MO :#Yesu’Mwira ulabire (Alabire),#Yesu’Mwira ulabire (Alabire),#Wamaw’iniakulamya, Walak’iniakowa,#Yesu y’Omwira ulabire.##Ngeghay’Omwira ulabire, Syalingung’omo malighe,#Nyireke anzodole, Sihali Eryubaha,#Yesu y’Omwira ulabire.##Nery’obulighe bwamahika, Ibwandetera eryubaha,#Sinzwek’omo mutima, Nikwa ambanganire,#Yesu y’Omwira ulabire.##Twasyabya twahik’elubula, Twahindana n’abo twasigha,#Wasingya wasyabugha, Tukamupipa Iye,#Yesu y’Omwira ulabire.

title: Mwami Apipawe
alias: To God Be The Glory##CH 647 - Doh is Ab
content: Mwami apipaw’omo myatsi yosi,#Olwanzo luwe ka mwatuma Yesu.#Ka mwayiteka eribya ho liwe,#Tubye neyo engebe y’erikota.##ERISUBA MO :#Mupipe, mupipe, Ekihugho kyosi#Mupipe, mupipe, Abandu batseme#Na wase ku Tata, Ku Yesu Mwana#Iwasyamup’omo myatsi yosi.##Rilama ryoswire, Bihembo byetu,#Ngaghane y’Omwami oko kihugho.#Abakamwikiriraya kwenene;#Abo bobawite eribuyirwa.##Mwatukangirirya myatsi minene,#Abiritubwir’erilama ryetu,#Neryo eky’eriswekera kinene,#Yesu akasyas’itwamulola ko.

title: Omubuyirire, Mwami Mutoki
alias: Holy, Holy, Holy##CH 73 - Doh is E
content: Omubuyirire, Mwami Mutoki,#Mo ngyakyakya, twasyapip’itunemwimba.#Omubuyirire, Mwami gh’olukogho,#Mwami w’ebyosi, Kera na kera.##Omubuyirire, N’Abalaika,#Bangi kundu banemukusaba abosi.#Kighonye n’ebighonye, banemukusaba,#Oyutula na kera na kera.##Omubuyirire, Yukalamaya,#Omwirimya syalikubis’ekindu kyosi.#Omubuyirire, Uwu wene kundu,#Uli n’amaka mangi n’olwanzo.
